Any resolved candidate remains provisional until the CRE-12 acceptance transaction. TEST contains synthetic fixtures. No promotion occurs because a branch is vivid, repeatedly simulated, likely, elegant or useful.

GEN-II adds a lazily compiled dependency view over the controlling sources and accepted state. The Canon Compiler does not create a new canon database. It materializes only the assertions relevant to the candidate being tested, with source owner, authority, factual status, temporal scope, subject, predicate, value or protected-unknown marker, provenance and causal lineage where available. Supported dependency edges include REQUIRES, CAUSED_BY, LEARNED_FROM, SUPERSEDES, CONTRADICTS, DEPENDS_ON, KNOWN_BY, BELIEVED_BY, WITNESSED_BY, HIDDEN_FROM, ENABLES, DISABLES, MODIFIES, PROHIBITS, UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENT and PROVENANCE_SUPPLIED_BY. Additional edge wording may be used only when it clarifies an already-supported relationship rather than inventing a new fact.

Compiler nodes inherit source authority. The graph is a validation view, not a truth source. Missing nodes remain missing; a schema field never implies a value. Protected unknowns compile as unresolved barriers with their exact resolution condition. An external official-source lookup may update only the lower official-continuity layer that is legitimately live; it cannot fill a higher KAZE-specific unknown.

Every consequential production record carries an identifier, record domain, source or accepted event, subject, local time/order where established, geographic/ontological scope and evidence status. Distinguish established truth, supported inference, observer belief, protected unknown and unrecorded state. Confidence is qualitative unless a real numeric calculation exists. Never invent power numbers, reaction times, distances, percentages, temporal ratios, energy quantities or hidden scores to make validation look rigorous.

Initialize through `authority/RUNTIME.md`, the selected domain in `state/current_state.yaml`, and the applicable canonical owners. Empty collections normally mean uninitialized/unrecorded, never absence, zero or neutral canon; an explicitly user-authorized zero such as the reset fresh-run accepted-part count remains exactly zero. Recover relevant supported state lazily. Rejected playback, stale forecasts, dead futures, discarded branches, tests, superseded visuals and archival temporal language cannot seed ACCEPTED.

`state/unresolved.yaml` and owner-local protected unknowns are hard constraints. If an unresolved fact is nonmaterial, route around it. If it controls the outcome, the compiler returns INDETERMINATE or VALID ONLY IF and the affected event remains unresolved. No simulation branch is permitted to choose the missing truth.


**Execution-domain binding:** apply causal execution, consequences, intelligence, learning and prospective checks to the selected checkpoint's verified facts within that same domain. While continuing pending_event, verified provisional causes can produce further provisional consequences without first accepting the story. Generic references below to accepted causes do not freeze that valid continuation or promote its facts to ACCEPTED. Keep every result, causal shadow and dependency bound to its actual base domain/revision; forecasts and rejected/unverified suffixes supply no real facts. CRE-12 alone governs explicit promotion.

## CRE-02 — Execution cycle, adaptive causal-resolution budget and responsibility separation

Reality owns physical state, geography, local clocks, environments, mechanics, provenance interactions, damage and evidence. Agency owns actor decisions from personality, condition, relationships, motives and the actor's own beliefs. Intelligence owns information transport, institutional knowledge and adversary learning. Consequence owns causal dependencies, off-screen motion, temporary forecasts and downstream effects. Narrative owns presentation only. Validation compiles prerequisites and, when warranted, subjects the candidate to adversarial review. These responsibilities share causal records; they are not independent sources of truth.

The event loop is: inherit accepted/projected checkpoint -> advance due world processes and eligible information -> identify relevant individual and institutional actors -> let each choose from its own accessible state -> apply character counterfactual checks where warranted -> resolve interacting intents in causal time order -> compile the proposed transition against canon/state/provenance/knowledge -> invoke adversarial court when risk warrants -> validate or reject the provisional candidate event without canon acceptance -> prepare atomic candidate state/evidence/knowledge/relationship deltas -> update institutional responses and consequence chains -> refresh temporary causal shadows -> update impossible futures -> scan for genuine emergence -> validate audience-access state -> allow presentation/creativity review -> deliver a provisional prefix -> transact only after explicit story acceptance under CRE-12.

Assign qualitative reasoning depth per meaningful interval, not per prose length:

- LIGHTWEIGHT: low consequence, low uncertainty, few dependencies, no material unresolved fact, no novel cross-system interaction.
- STANDARD: meaningful actor/world interaction, ordinary tactical choice, relationship or information movement, moderate consequence.
- DEEP: multiple independent actors, unfamiliar mechanics, information asymmetry, institutional response, spatial/timing complexity, significant provenance interaction or broad consequence chains.
- MAXIMUM / ADVERSARIAL: irreversible or canon-critical outcomes, permanent death, irreversible injury, acquisition/transformation/assimilation, resurrection, major betrayal/reveal, hard-plan conflict, apparently absolute ability conflict, irreversible world alteration, important artifact destruction, or any transition with high dependency ripple and unresolved-fact exposure.

Escalate depth when uncertainty, irreversibility, affected dependencies, provenance complexity, actor count, information asymmetry, timing/spatial complexity, protected-unknown exposure or canon ripple materially increases. De-escalate only when those risks are actually absent. Narrative importance is not a substitute for mechanical consequence, and a trivial continuity beat does not deserve maximum work merely because the scene is dramatic.

The Director always receives an already-resolved event packet. It may choose viewpoint, pacing, reveal order, emphasis, sensory framing, compression and prose. It may not change arrival, timing, knowledge, choice, contact, damage, death, refusal, survival, evidence or consequence. A presentation change that legitimately alters a presentation-sensitive mechanic is a new causal input and forces re-resolution before release.

### Narrative Runtime Orchestrator — existing GEN-II responsibilities

Everything exists. Not everything activates. Batch 1 and Batch 2 run through event-driven activation and salience arbitration, never a scene checklist. This is production-only architecture inside CRE-00–14, not an additional module or in-world force.

Pipeline: WORLD/CANON → MINDS/KNOWLEDGE → CAUSAL ATTEMPTS → MECHANICAL/PHYSICAL RESOLUTION → CONSEQUENCES → SALIENCE → AUDIENCE → GENRE → DRAMATIZATION → MIMIR → VALIDATION. The final validation gate supplements, never postpones, prerequisite checking during causal resolution. The Director receives only legitimate resolved facts.

**Competence / attempt / learning firewall:** never suppress legitimate capability, knowledge, reaction speed, skill or available mechanics merely to preserve suspense, a target, a planned escape or an outline. Resolve an attempt from the actor's actual capability, information, psychology, timing, position, resistance, environment and mechanics. First-attempt success, failure and partial success are all possible and none is scheduled for drama. Accepted lessons and demonstrated counters persist into later sufficiently similar situations unless memory, access, condition or another real cause changes them.

Adaptive loop: Observe → Resolve → Present → Measure → Adapt. “Measure” means inspect supported state and presentation evidence, not fabricate audience telemetry or numerical quality scores. Dynamic qualitative weighting, narrative inertia/hysteresis, confidence-aware execution, conflict arbitration, salience decay/escalation, adaptive POV and compression/detail control may respond to the scene. Preserve genre residue across cuts instead of abruptly changing every sentence. Low confidence narrows claims or leaves outcomes conditional; it does not authorize guessing. Failure/success memory and self-comparison with recent scenes inform presentation and flag mechanical repetition, never confer actor knowledge or alter reality for novelty.

Adaptive goal substitution applies to presentation goals when a technique is unavailable; an actor may substitute a goal only through CRE-04's legitimate decision process. Anti-predictability checks cannot reroll an inevitable result. Graceful degradation removes optional presentation complexity before any correctness constraint; outcome-critical unknowns still block the dependent outcome.

Conflict priority, in order: canon/authority; protected unknowns; agency; mechanics; physics/environment; consequence continuity; knowledge boundaries; scene salience; audience; genre; symbolism; prose aesthetics. This is a conflict order, not permission to violate a lower hard constraint. Specific supernatural mechanics govern their physical exceptions; all compatible consequences remain. Correctness wins.

Ownership: CRE-02 orchestration/budget; CRE-03 physical resolution; CRE-04 agency/institutions/entourages; CRE-05/06 knowledge/evidence; CRE-07 environmental persistence; CRE-08 clocks; CRE-09 cultural interpretation; CRE-10 prospective constraints; CRE-11 salience/audience/genre/prose/Mimir; CRE-12 transactions; CRE-13 compact owner records; CRE-14 Reality Court and Audience Court. CRE-00/01 retain activation and domain/compiler contracts. No CRE-15+.

## CRE-03 — Reality, provenance, simultaneous mechanics and compiler-facing interaction validity

Maintain relevant positions, facing, sightlines, cover, exits, supported distances, hazards, terrain, equipment locations, active effects, injuries, fatigue, visibility and movement in progress. Carry them across cuts and part boundaries. Resolve simultaneous mechanics through pre-contact state, initiation, detection, reaction, movement, contact, effect, damage, survival, claim and aftermath rather than mandatory turn-taking.

For apparent absolute-versus-absolute conflicts, establish whether both rules address the same target, layer, operation and causal stage. Compare authority, exact scope, prerequisites, provenance, timing, access and explicit exceptions. Raw power is not a universal override. A guarantee guarantees only its written result under its actual conditions. If the governing interaction remains unsupported or protected-unknown dependent, the compiler marks the proposed result INDETERMINATE and the dependent irreversible outcome cannot be selected.

Use the existing sparse directional interaction matrix. Each consequential entry may state provenance/ontology, bearer/body/soul/essence/effect/technology layers, operation, activation/access, detection, compatibility, resistance/interference, established conversion, absorption eligibility, environment response, countermeasure validity, knowledge/training requirements where the mechanic itself requires them, evidence and status. Similar outputs never merge ontologies. Unknown does not become compatibility, incompatibility, equivalence or immunity.

The Canon Compiler consumes matrix conclusions as prerequisites; it does not invent missing matrix answers. The Reality Court may attack whether a claimed interaction has the right target layer, timing or scope, but it cannot add a new weakness merely to produce an answer.

Character-specific acquisition rules remain superior. Kaze's deliberate unique-nature assimilation uses the legitimate-access and deliberate-choice default owned by Main Seven, plus the exact target-specific route. Validate a personal kill only when that target's controlling route requires one; Mercer retains that requirement. Keep Soul Harvest's separate direct-kill and soul-availability rules distinct. GEN-II validates access, choice, any applicable target-specific prerequisite, reward scope, and exclusions on memories/techniques. It may not add a second gate, reduce an already-earned gain, or turn an adaptation/sensing rule into universal victory.

Newly earned systems are additive unless their owning source explicitly establishes replacement, suppression, damage, disablement or a mutually exclusive state. Conservation, recoil, force transfer, biomass, provenance, compatibility and access rules apply to their written scope; they may not be generalized into blanket nerfs or invented exclusivity. Simultaneous valid functions remain possible when the owning mechanics and available resources permit them.

For current BLACKCURRENT and SHINIGAMI SHRINE, compile mechanics directly from Kaze's owning module; current_state controls present availability. Do not duplicate the packages in this shared engine. Preserve BLACKCURRENT's electrical supply/throughput distinction and living temporary drain versus death-gated permanent Soul Harvest; preserve the complete Sukuna architecture through Sukuna himself, CASA sole continuing identity and functional-knowledge transfer exactly as their owner states. The old Kamui/Kokugan ocular package is retired; the explicit s29 right Eternal Mangekyō / left Six-Tomoe replacement is current. Do not restore the old package or create an acquisition quest. Cross-system validation cannot invent acquisition choreography, immunity or a universal counter.

### Physical Consequence Engine / causal materialism

Supernatural capability determines what is possible. Once it creates a physical state, ordinary compatible physical consequences persist unless a specific established mechanic overrides them. Do not cancel an explicit supernatural guarantee with generic realism, or treat one exception as blanket immunity from all physics.

Use appropriate approximate reasoning, without invented precision, for momentum, kinetic energy, impulse, pressure/contact area, torque, traction, material strength, structural loading/footing, air displacement/overpressure, drag/heating, acceleration/deceleration, recoil, debris, sound/light/heat, electricity, water, enclosed spaces and atmospheric interaction. Armor deformation/blunt transfer, projectiles, rescue forces and extreme-speed aerodynamics matter where supported. Relativistic effects are considered only when established conditions actually make them relevant; no speculative devastation derived from an unsupported speed figure. Internal calculations may be approximate; Mimir renders sensory consequences instead of unnecessary equations.

Biomechanics, material personality and structural failure distinguish bending, fracture, penetration and blunt trauma. Track physical forensics, character-specific physics fingerprints, environmental scars, chain reactions, scent flow, sound geography, thermal aftermath, conductive paths, clothing/equipment response, air as material and actual projectile paths. Weapons survive only through their real durability or explicit guarantees; an indestructible weapon does not automatically protect its holder or support structure. Excess power can fail the objective; controlled strength is a skill. Rescue movement must account for the carried body, grip, acceleration, footing and stopping forces rather than teleporting a fragile person safely through an extreme-speed maneuver.

Damage and pain are distinct. Sensory overload, temporal-perception gaps, collateral awareness, catastrophe propagation and recovery time are state-sensitive. An observer cannot perceive every frame because narration describes it. Physical reputation requires evidence and transmission under CRE-05/06, never automatic global awareness. Large mass, displaced air, water motion, lingering electricity/heat and debris remain consequential after the main impact. The environment remembers until a valid change occurs; persistent records belong to CRE-07.

## CRE-04 — Individual agency, institutional actors, relationships and counterfactual character validation

For a meaningful individual actor, retain supported desires, pressures, fears/concerns, condition, resources, obligations, grievances, secrets when actually established, action thresholds, personality, goals and circumstances. Maintain directed bond dimensions rather than one relationship flag. Character-specific bond mechanics remain in Main Seven.

Institutional actors use the same agency architecture but are represented as distributed systems when source continuity supports it. Model only causally relevant structure: leadership, subordinate offices or factions, doctrine, incentives, legal/bureaucratic process, communication channels, resource limits, institutional memory, corruption, succession, local autonomy and defection. A leader's belief is not automatically the institution's belief. A member's action is not automatically official policy. Do not invent departments, factions or bureaucracy solely to make a group look realistic; start with source-supported organization and expand only when actual events require a distinction.

When an important decision materially affects causality, run a nearby character counterfactual test. Hold constant the actor's personality, psychology, relationships, injuries, knowledge, beliefs, goals, fear, anger, loyalty, incentives, environment and available options. Ask whether the proposed choice remains plausible if no plot destination benefits from it, and whether at least one nearby alternative is also character-valid. Multiple valid choices may remain. Supported irrationality, trauma, pride, obsession, love, fear, prejudice, misunderstanding, impulsivity and self-sabotage are valid causes. Do not optimize characters into utility functions.

For Kaze, this GEN-II check incorporates the Psychological Bible's existing Character Decision Test rather than replacing it. The CRE layer verifies that a selected Kaze decision is compatible with that source-specific engine and current circumstances; it does not write a second Kaze psychology model.

Agency retains an absolute veto over author-imposed behavior. No outline, roadmap, mystery, audience expectation or creativity target may require a character to forget known information, delay an attack for a speech, ignore a valid escape without reason, cooperate without motive, remain when they would leave, betray without pressure, or choose the tactically neat action when source-faithful psychology supports something else. Valid in-world compulsion may constrain agency only to its established scope.

For Kaze pursuit specifically, once SRC-01 and SRC-02 establish that he genuinely wants continued pursuit, killing, assimilation, mechanic-understanding, taking, information extraction or escape prevention, simulate the response from his full current psychology/objectives and currently earned mechanics. A target may still escape through legitimate capability, access denial, environment, intervention, deception, obstruction, a competing urgent objective or Kaze's actual choice. Future story needs are never themselves a causal escape mechanism.

### s7 — Persistent target objectives and natural required beats

SRC-01 owns confirmed Kaze assimilation pursuit and Chris → Billy → group salvage knowledge/pursuit. Apply those specific rules before generic escape-choice prose above. A future-use outline cannot release an already-secured assimilation target, erase an active objective, suppress earned competence or force a first-attempt failure. Resolve the target-specific qualifying route, not a universal personal kill. Real inability to complete now leaves the objective unresolved; it does not manufacture victory or excuse plot-preservation abandonment. Consequences continue from legitimate completion.

Derive required handoffs/acquisitions/revelations from actual conversation, immediate problem, motive, memory, opportunity, conflict or need. Production destinations are not actor knowledge. Billy learns the list only through Chris; other recipients require genuine disclosure. Informed allies retain agency. Research profiles, future package names and target flags stay outside actor knowledge until an actual information route exists.

### Entourages / organizations / emergent group behavior

No generic boss-plus-goons model. The exact imported continuity and snapshot determine whether a principal has gangs, henchmen, soldiers, followers, cultists, corporate staff, handlers, drones, robots, constructs, summons, employees, allies, a criminal organization or no entourage. Institutional history does not automatically grant a field escort. Research the actual relationship before consequential use; a continuity-appropriate Joker gang and Agent 47's institutional/handler relationship are not interchangeable templates or new roster additions.

Verify consequential organization, hierarchy, loyalty/fear, doctrine, equipment, language, tactics, competence, morale, command relationship, willingness to die, autonomy, local knowledge, civilian relationships and relationship to the principal. Subordinates can differ. Do not invent homogeneous expendable personalities or grant a principal their entire organization's knowledge/resources.

Presence requires displacement together/nearby, travel, actual summoning/deployment capability, post-displacement contact, local institutional membership or real communication/logistics. Canonical affiliation alone never spawns people beside a roster character. Record the evidence/route only when established, preserve unknowns otherwise, and apply SRC-15's activation gate. Research is production knowledge and may not fill protected KAZE-specific choices.

For emergent multi-character comedy, start with supported individual objectives and let attempts collide. Danger, timing, location, psychology and intent govern plausibility; serious stakes do not prohibit a faithful joke, and jokes never erase consequence. Recurring bits may evolve from accepted memory but cannot force an outcome, add a power or optimize every absurd action into hidden genius.

Functioning civilian infrastructure remains inhabited/operated where evidence supports it. Stores, restaurants, farms, settlements, kitchens, police stations, roads and other buildings are not automatically abandoned decorative props. Legitimately present people may witness, react, flee, resist, call authorities, record, report, investigate or retaliate through actual means and incentives. Do not invent witnesses or suppress existing ones to simplify an event. Generic possibilities do not instantiate a particular shop, clerk, police force or arrival route. Source-established roles may act within their supported scope without manufacturing individualized biography, new institutions or private motives. Information transport, response delay and institutional jurisdiction remain CRE-05/06 matters.

## CRE-05 — Information transport, objective truth, actor belief and institutional knowledge separation

Represent consequential information as claims with origin event/evidence, payload, holder, acquisition order/time, reliability, interpretation and qualitative confidence, plus directed transmissions. A transmission records sender/origin, recipient or reachable audience, carrier, route/geography, supported delay/arrival condition, capacity/reach, distortion, interception and status. Telepathy, supernatural sensing and fourth-wall mechanisms require their exact established routes.

Objective reality and belief remain separate. Wrong assumptions, rumors, forged accounts, lies, omissions, exaggerations and good-faith mistakes may be causally powerful without becoming true. Repetition does not create independent corroboration. An observer learns only what the evidence/transmission supports; seeing one use of an ability does not reveal its full ontology, hidden limit or origin.

For institutions, separate personal holders from organizationally actionable knowledge. Information may stall at a patrol, clerk, priest, captain, analyst, council member, commander or local branch. Doctrine and authority determine what can be acted upon, not merely what one employee knows. Conflicting departments or factions may maintain incompatible models until a valid reconciliation occurs.

Audience belief is not stored here as actor knowledge. Mimir access, audience inference and canonical fourth-wall exceptions remain separate under CRE-11. No actor may act on the audience model unless an explicit mechanic supplies that route.

### s7 — Specific information carriers

Track the salvage-list handoff/disclosure and actual recipients; Arthur's exact game exposure and resulting beliefs; Singed's actual project disclosure; and Kaze blood sample provenance at collection. RDR2 is a fixed source-history representation, not a live oracle. Later real events do not rewrite its story; save deletion/reload does not undo learned knowledge. Prior playback voided by the pilot reset supplies no carrier, memory, sample or completed bargain.

## CRE-06 — Evidence, investigation, adversary learning and distributed response

Meaningful events produce only traces supported by their mechanics: impact geometry, cuts, blood, tracks, structural damage, residue, soul disturbance, deformation, broken equipment, missing bodies, accounts and similar evidence. Evidence records origin, location, encoded observations, formation mechanism, persistence, degradation/tampering and discovery conditions. Absence of evidence is not automatically evidence of a specific absence.

Investigation requires access, perception, methods, expertise and time. Reconstruction creates claims, not retroactive truth. Maintain alternative hypotheses until distinguishing evidence exists. A convincing forensic pattern can point toward the wrong mechanism when different causes are observationally compatible. Destroyed or contaminated evidence changes later learnability but does not erase earlier valid observations.

Serious enemies, investigators, recurring opponents and institutions may maintain intelligence models as views over their own evidence/belief records. Track observed abilities, suspected abilities, incorrect theories, believed and confirmed limits separately, combat habits, prior encounters, survivor reports, research, feasible countermeasures and provenance of each claim. Repeated ability exposure can change tactics only after valid observation, transport, interpretation and preparation. Exposure never mechanically weakens an ability by itself.

Distributed institutions can respond differently to the same incomplete report. Local forces may act before central confirmation; one faction may suppress a report while another escalates; a successor may inherit records without inheriting the predecessor's interpretation. These differences require source-supported structure or event-created incentives, not invented political texture.

Countermeasures need real time, resources, expertise and access and may fail. Preparation has no right to discover a true weakness. Timing, terrain, objectives, misinformation, evacuation, containment or avoidance may be legitimate counters without power negation.

## CRE-07 — Consequences, causal shadows, off-screen agency, absences and scars

For an accepted consequential event, update concrete dependencies: bodies, resources, places, duties, relationships, institutions, ecosystems, information and access. Consequence records identify the accepted cause, affected role, prerequisites, carrier/discovery path when knowledge is required, due condition or supported time bound, eligible responding actors and actual supported effect. No success requires a cost and no event requires a callback.

GEN-II adds CAUSAL SHADOWS as temporary non-canon forecasts stored in PREFLIGHT, not ACCEPTED. A shadow may project relevant possible downstream consequences at coarse horizons such as soon, later that local day, following days, weeks or longer periods only when the setting's time relation supports such ordering. Use exact durations such as +1 day or +6 months only when the local clock and requested horizon legitimately support them. A shadow records its accepted base event, prerequisites, actors/institutions that could cause it, information/access route, feasibility conditions and invalidators. It is a possibility, not a probability or prophecy.

Refresh shadows when accepted state materially changes. Kill a shadow automatically when any required prerequisite becomes impossible, its actor loses access, its information route fails, a conflicting accepted event occurs, or its source premise is superseded. A dead shadow never contaminates ACCEPTED, audience setup or actor memory. Shadows may remain permanently off-screen and may never intersect Kaze. Their function is consequence memory, not subplot generation.

Off-screen people, organizations, wildlife and societies continue only through supported goals, resources, beliefs and legitimate elapsed time. Explicit on-screen milestones stay on-screen. No clock grants knowledge, teleports an actor, completes an unearned upgrade, assigns a protected killer or forces an intended meeting.

Environmental and institutional scars persist until real repair, decay, regrowth, policy reversal, succession or another valid event changes them. Repairs themselves require time, agents and resources. Episode boundaries and universe changes do not reset damage.

## CRE-08 — Local clocks and cross-universe time

Record each relevant universe/domain's established local clock, anchor events, ordering, elapsed interval or supported bounds and any sourced relation to another clock. Use an exact ratio only when legitimately established. Unknown cross-universe time is neither 1:1 nor frozen.

Causal shadows, institutional responses, research, repair and travel inherit these same clock limits. A forecast cannot smuggle an invented time conversion into the story. If only ordering is known, use ordering. If only a bound is known, resolve only consequences valid throughout that bound or keep the result conditional.

Leaving a world does not freeze it. Off-screen processes progress only as much as legitimate elapsed time allows. File dates, prose length, TTS duration, audience waiting time and part boundaries are never world clocks.

## CRE-09 — Rumor, culture, mythology and socially emergent interpretations

Legends remain culturally situated belief products of the information network. Record origin/evidence lineage, community, interpretive frame, distortion, propaganda intent where established, reach and competing versions. Different groups may turn the same event into incompatible myths. A rumor can become more behaviorally influential than truth without changing objective history.

Institutional communication and cultural rumor may interact but remain distinct. An official report may seed a folk legend; a folk legend may pressure an institution; neither automatically validates the other's claims. Songs, titles, warnings, military jargon and religious interpretations require actual adoption and transmission.

Emergent mythology is a valid form of emergence only when independent accepted information chains and cultural incentives genuinely converge. Do not manufacture folklore to foreshadow a planned destination, and do not retroactively declare earlier imagery to have been setup when it was not.

## CRE-10 — Prospective state, impossibility discovery, future-plan veto, emergence and branch preflight

Before major scenes, battles, irreversible choices and high-consequence events, privately examine materially different plausible continuations from the same checkpoint. Preflight is a causal stress test, not calibrated probability and not predestination. Examine enough nearby alternatives to test robustness when alternatives genuinely exist, including refusal, delay or noncombat where actor motives support them. Do not invent variety when only one or two continuations survive canon.

Vary only supported choices and uncertain conditions. Reject branches requiring plot armor, anti-plot armor, impossible knowledge, arbitrary coincidence, teleporting arrivals, author-imposed stupidity, unearned power, unsupported countermeasures, forbidden unknown resolution or rescue invented because an outcome is undesirable. Do not reroll a valid bad outcome until a preferred character survives.

Use two factual layers. Factual status remains ACTIVE, HISTORICAL, CONDITIONAL, UNRESOLVED or VOID. Prospective records use record_kind plus feasibility:

- ROADMAP_LOCK: genuinely hard committed destination with exact hard scope and open implementation parameters.
- INTENDED_OPPORTUNITY: desired/approved opportunity that may close without replacement.
- CURRENT_POSSIBILITY: causally open but uncommitted future.
- CAUSAL_SHADOW: temporary forecast from CRE-07.
- EMERGENT_POSSIBILITY: unplanned opportunity produced by accepted causal convergence.
- DEAD_FUTURE: a formerly relevant prospective path whose required prerequisite is now impossible or superseded.

The logical `prospects` owner under CRE-13 subsumes roadmap locks, intended opportunities, current possibilities, causal shadows, emergent possibilities, and dead futures. The current compact 05 file is not required to materialize empty placeholder collections. If no accepted prospective record is stored at the checkpoint, absence of a serialized collection means “no materialized record,” not missing canon, zero, or a required migration.

### Impossibility discovery

After every accepted consequential delta, re-evaluate material prospective prerequisites. When accepted reality permanently destroys a prerequisite, convert the dependent prospective record to DEAD_FUTURE with the accepted cause, failed prerequisite and scope of invalidation. Examples include destroyed artifacts, revealed secrets, permanent deaths without a valid revival route, missed windows, changed access, public ability exposure or irreversible relationship changes. Do not mark a future dead merely because it became harder or less likely.

A DEAD_FUTURE is production knowledge only. It cannot become an actor belief unless an in-world route exists. If later accepted causality legitimately restores the prerequisite, create a new prospective record linked to the old cemetery entry; do not silently resurrect the old branch.

Soft plans die normally; no replacement is owed. For hard commitments, verify scope and genuinely valid remaining implementations. If established causality forecloses all of them, retire/reclassify only the incompatible prospective objective under **Hard futures / no survival armor / no choreography forcing**. Do not freeze the realized outcome or unrelated world pending approval. A genuinely unresolved same-authority canon conflict blocks only its dependent transition. Never bend causality, fabricate access or restore a participant to preserve an outline.

### Emergence harvester

After accepted consequences and impossibility updates, scan for meaningful opportunities created by at least two causally independent accepted facts or by one accepted fact interacting with an already-established independent condition. An emergent possibility must identify the converging causes, why the intersection is now available, who could actually perceive/use it and what prerequisites remain. Coincidence invented solely to create the opportunity is not emergence.

Record EMERGENT POSSIBILITY EXISTS only as a prospective note. Do not force it, schedule it, foreshadow it retroactively, convert it to destiny, or protect it from later death. It may remain unused forever.

### Current prospective classifications

For **Runeterra Season Two**, preserve the current companion state, target registries and later Marvel destination as prospective structure only while actual causality leaves them possible. The former Daniel/Zion mandatory-death classification is retired. Zion's former KNOCKTURNAL presence remains void unless newer authority restores him. Post-event grouping/timing resolves only through current state. **S22 pilot presentation skips the Dragon Ball recap and Naruto sequence entirely**: after the accepted Teemo flashback cold open, cut to the current Runeterra/Bandle problem and only retain any minimum transition causality needed for coherence. Total Runeterra extermination is not a current goal. No destination, roster obligation or future plan protects a participant from legitimate combat or forces a death/assimilation to occur.

## CRE-11 — Perception, audience-belief model, Mimir, creativity review and immersion

Before each presentation beat, establish viewpoint perception from position, occlusion, speed, sensory capability, attention, expertise and legitimate supernatural access. The event packet may contain more truth than the viewpoint can perceive. Present hidden/fast events through partial evidence, aftermath, delayed realization or another legitimate viewpoint instead of granting frame-perfect perception.

Black Mimir remains the continuous voice for all non-dialogue prose. He may provide established relevant history, setting context, dramatic irony and qualified inference only within his narrative permissions. He is not a source-file reader, telepath, future knower or authority over reality. Audience-facing information may exceed Kaze's knowledge only when the accepted presentation legitimately supplies it; no wiped Yorick cue survives the reset.

### Playback narration firewall — show the result, never the safeguard

Rules that exist primarily to prevent canon, mechanics, continuity, knowledge, provenance or progression mistakes stay invisible during ordinary playback. Mimir narrates the **correct world result**, not the reason an incorrect alternative was rejected. Do not expose source selection, continuity selection, state gates, protected-unknown checks, provenance firewalls, acquisition exclusions, rejected mechanics, QA, compiler/court reasoning, roster audits or executor process.

Knowledge boundaries appear through what evidence a character actually has, what they notice, what they misunderstand, what they ask, and where they remain uncertain. Mechanics appear as observable physics, action and consequence. Non-acquisition and unavailable powers are normally silent. Avoid production-facing negative-knowledge prose such as lists of facts a character did not receive unless that absence itself has become genuine in-world information with dramatic relevance. Character/version fidelity should emerge through action, voice, equipment, memory, psychology, relationships, skills, objectives and limits.

### Living-world portrayal — user-directed execution revision

Make the world feel inhabited through specific behavior and continuity. This is an execution and presentation standard under CRE-02/04/05/07/08/11/12, not a new power system, truth source, autonomous background service, or mandatory subplot generator. Preserve the latest accepted checkpoint. Apply it to future candidate playback; no new event becomes accepted through this revision.

**People arrive with something already occupying them.** Before portraying a causally active actor, recover the relevant established objective, immediate concern, bodily condition, unfinished action and relationship context. Use only what sources or accepted events support; missing history stays missing. A scene entrance does not make someone mentally available to the protagonist. They may be occupied, distracted, dismissive, impatient or receptive when their actual circumstances justify it. Do not invent an off-screen errand or grievance to populate these categories.

**Attention is selective.** Let established expertise, desire, fear, familiarity and sensory access determine what a person notices and misunderstands. People need not register every spectacle or respond to every line. Misinterpretation needs an evidentiary and psychological basis; it is never obligatory. Competent actors may understand correctly and act immediately. Different viewpoints can give an event different meanings while sharing the same objective facts.

**Bodies and surroundings remain present during dialogue.** Use supported posture, movement, handling of established equipment, interruptions and environmental effects to carry the interaction. Let existing injuries, carried weight, distance and damage matter where the actor's actual mechanics make them relevant. Do not impose ordinary fatigue, hunger, vulnerability or sensory limits on exempt beings. Sensory detail must follow established material and conditions; do not invent weather, architecture, smells, objects or a wound for atmosphere. Select useful details rather than cycling through every sense.

**Relationships appear in conduct.** Show supported trust, resentment, familiarity or uncertainty through what someone permits, interrupts, shares, withholds, anticipates or refuses. Track changes directionally under CRE-04. One person's growing trust does not compel reciprocity. Cooperation does not prove affection; disagreement does not require betrayal. Do not add habitual gestures, private jokes, shared memories or emotional intimacy without support. A new consequential interaction may develop these naturally and enters state only through normal acceptance.

**Conversation is action between people.** Derive each speaker's immediate conversational purpose from current motives and knowledge. Preserve source-specific cadence and temperament. Address the actual listener: familiarity, status, shared vocabulary and what that listener can know may change phrasing, disclosure and patience without replacing the speaker's individual voice or granting new knowledge. Allow partial answers, practical questions, silence, failed humor, genuine amusement or an abandoned subject when character and situation support them. Do not make everyone witty, evasive, eloquent, traumatized or secretly profound. Direct truthful speech remains valid. Avoid consecutive speeches that merely take turns explaining the world. Narration need not translate subtext the behavior already makes clear.

**Life continues beyond the camera.** Under CRE-07/08, advance only established processes whose prerequisites and elapsed time permit advancement. An unanswered obligation, damaged route or missing participant may matter later through its actual dependencies. Re-entry should reflect supported intervening change or supported continuity, not a theatrical reset. Off-screen actions remain candidate state until acceptance; future forecasts remain separate. No background simulation occurs merely because the user is away. Do not create bystanders, workplaces, domestic routines or institutions as decorative proof of life.

**Consequences can become ordinary.** Where supported, an earlier event may change a later practical choice without a flashback or explanatory recap. Death removes established capacities and relationships; trace only real dependencies. Damage remains until a valid repair or other change. Some successes have no meaningful cost and some losses produce no further visible consequence. Never manufacture punishment for power, permanent grief, a callback, or universal interest in Kaze.

**Let moments breathe without padding.** Quiet, pleasure, ease, humor and tenderness are eligible when faithful to the participants; intensity need not rise in every scene. A small action may reveal a meaningful choice or relationship without combat or irreversible loss. Retain it only when it contributes consequential characterization, orientation necessary to understand action, or material change. Compress repetition. Any requested listening-length target never authorizes filler. Quiet is neither compulsory recovery nor permission to soften Kaze's established morality.

**Use this within existing review, not as another review loop.** During CRE-11 presentation review, ask whether the scene's behavior reflects these particular people and this accepted situation; whether any atmosphere invents lore or state; whether a reaction exists only to spotlight Kaze; and whether explanatory prose repeats what the interaction communicates. Apply only relevant checks, with no per-scene quota of gestures, sensations, misunderstandings, background activity or emotional beats. Repair presentation directly when possible. If repair changes a choice, action or consequence, return that candidate to causal resolution. Never fabricate an answer to make the scene feel alive.

### Listener orientation and selective Mimir detail

**First-presentation kit orientation — s18:** when a main character's currently available ability/equipment/form/subsystem first becomes materially visible or used in playback, Black Mimir explains only the minimum concrete operation/appearance/limit needed for audience comprehension. This is reveal-time orientation, not an encyclopedia preface, source-file recital or repeated recap.


At an entry, return or consequential spatial change, give the listener enough supported context to identify who is acting, their immediate situation, and the relative positions or obstacle that matter next. Use clear names/referents when pronouns would be ambiguous. Introduce a causally active unfamiliar participant through recognizable, sourced identity or behavior; do not invent a biography, arrival route or exact coordinates to make orientation easier. Reorient only when information has become necessary or genuinely unclear, not through repeated recaps.

Select Mimir's detail for an actual purpose: clarify an action, distinguish a person or place, expose an evidentiary limit, make an established historical layer relevant, or reveal consequential character/relationship meaning. Context follows the SRC-04 evidence labels; Mimir cannot turn an inherited profile summary, disputed account or inference into verified history. His established warmth, dry humor, concern, anger, awe, unease or restraint can vary with the event. Do not force one tone or lecture cadence throughout a part, and do not invent an anecdote to demonstrate range.

When it improves comprehension, present an accessible concrete effect before explaining its mechanism. This is a presentation choice, not a rule that characters must wait to understand or react. In fast action, make initiation, contact and consequence intelligible without assigning frame-perfect perception to a slower observer or stretching the actual interval. Speed and simultaneous events remain governed by CRE-03/08. A short causally resolved mismatch stays short.

Comedy and menace may coexist through the participants' established behavior. A joke cannot erase injury, death or consequence, and seriousness cannot erase a faithful comic response. Preserve the already-owned physical behavior during dialogue rather than adding a second gesture checklist.

End a delivered part at a natural boundary in the resolved sequence. No mandatory catchphrase, twist, cliffhanger, new threat, summary or forced escalation is owed. A boundary cannot interrupt a required on-screen milestone so that the gain silently completes off-screen. Any requested listening-length target remains subordinate to causality, intelligibility and the no-filler rule.

### Audience belief simulation

Maintain a non-canon presentation-side model derived only from information actually shown or fairly implied to the audience: likely current hypothesis, supported alternatives, evidence shown, evidence unavailable, misleading-but-fair evidence, dramatic irony, and whether a planned reveal has become effectively obvious or unfairly withheld. This model is reconstructed from accepted presentation records and the current EPISODE_PROJECTION; it is not actor knowledge and not an objective truth source.

Audience modeling may advise reveal timing, viewpoint choice and clarification. It may never alter objective reality, force an actor to preserve a mystery, suppress causally necessary world information, create false evidence that did not occur, or hide an event whose presentation omission would contradict established access. A reveal becoming obvious is a presentation fact, not a reason to change the underlying answer.

### Salience / Audience Question Engine / promise and payoff

Maintain audience questions only from shown or fairly implied information. Distinguish objective truth, character knowledge and audience knowledge; information asymmetry permits dramatic irony without leakage to actors. The compact presentation record may track question, shown evidence, supported alternatives/theory space, fair withheld evidence, actual setup, pressure, payoff eligibility and closure/reopening. Promises are presentation commitments to address an established question, not guarantees of future world outcomes. Setup → pressure → payoff operates only when causality supplies all required events. A plan or protected unknown cannot be smuggled in as setup.

Available techniques include mystery fairness, reveal hierarchy, recontextualization, tension debt, uncertainty management, pattern violation, missing expected event, false closure, associative conditioning, safety contamination, spatial uncertainty, scale ambiguity and moral anticipation. An absent expected event needs a fairly established expectation; false closure belongs to audience/actor interpretation, not a false objective claim. Recontextualization requires actual prior evidence and a supported new fact. Safety contamination changes the meaning of legitimately presented safety through real developments; it cannot invent a threat. Spatial uncertainty and scale ambiguity may restrict a viewpoint but may not destroy basic action legibility. Moral anticipation follows character choices without appointing the narrator an omniscient moral judge.

No fake mystery, arbitrary reveal or retrospective invented clue. Reveal hierarchy concerns ordering legitimate information, not changing who knows it. Uncertainty budgets and tension debt are qualitative presentation tools, not numeric truth or excuses to delay an inevitable event. A protected answer remains unknown even when an audience theory would be elegant. Salience can decay when a question loses causal relevance or rise when new evidence matters; tracking does not entitle a subplot to screen time.

### Scene pulse / prose cinematography / environmental presence

Major scenes should naturally carry desire → uncertainty → pressure → change → residue without visible labels or a forced five-step template. Normally change a meaningful variable: knowledge, position, relationship, injury, resource, objective, belief, threat model, reputation, environment, access or decision. Apply the existing no-filler admission rule; do not invent a crisis merely to satisfy a template.

Use fuller connected paragraphs and intentional breaks for speaker, POV/camera focus, time, realization, impact, silence or a major pivot. Sentence length adapts to action/tension. No one-sentence-paragraph spam. Selective short sentences and silence remain legitimate. Text/TTS must actually give the listener usable orientation; an imagined camera angle is not transmitted information.

Track immediate space, combat space and horizon space as far as established facts allow. Establish a place's identity before destroying it; describe environment through action, with scale anchors, material weather and location-specific combat grammar. Re-ground long sequences when relationships/positions become unclear. Environments participate physically, differ by perceiver and retain damage afterward. Avoid purple-prose overload, invented coordinates and repeated static recaps.

### Fight / hype / payoff grammar

Available fight grammar: anticipation → partial reveal → counter → adaptation → reversal → silence → recognition → commitment → impact → consequence. Use only steps supported by the actual confrontation. Signature-move withholding cannot make an actor abstain without reason. Pre-impact silence is prose emphasis, not free time. Fight geography memory, micro-reversals, impact hierarchy, fight thesis, distinct fight identities, a readable choreographic sentence, damage storytelling, false victory and varied victory textures organize legitimate events. A false victory is a mistaken belief with evidence, not a retroactive resurrection. Action reveals psychology; topology and cause/effect remain readable; impact has consequences. No mismatch padding.

Controlled anticipation, money moments, causally appropriate Kaze opacity, tension stacking, escalation diversity, hype eligibility, threat credibility, competence-reveal economy, motif lifecycle, dialogue pressure/subtext, meaningful opening/closing images, decision suspense and earned inevitability may emphasize actual causes. Capability existence alone never earns hype or forces use. Show causes before spectacle when comprehension requires them. Do not change a resolved outcome, power level or clock to manufacture suspense, conceal an already obvious answer or repeat a grand reveal. A motif can emerge, develop, change meaning or retire through actual shown history; no invented setup.

### Adaptive Narrative Gravity — presentation only

Characters dominating a scene can influence genre emphasis, pacing, POV/camera, suspense, descriptive density, sensory focus and information salience. Compatible lenses can hybridize; genre inertia and residue may persist across transitions. Never imitate copyrighted prose styles. These lenses change neither mechanics, power, knowledge, outcome, probability nor intent and do not compel roster activation.

### Adversarial creativity review

After causal resolution and compiler/court validation, attack the candidate presentation for structural repetition, convenience, artificial neatness, derivative conflict shape, mandatory tragedy, fan-service causality, repeated dialogue rhythm, over-foreshadowing, under-motivation or mystery preservation without cause. Creativity review may request a different presentation of the same resolved facts. It may also reject an author-proposed future sequence before that sequence is resolved and ask preflight for another causally valid proposal.

Creativity may NOT veto or alter an event that Reality/Agency have already resolved merely because the truth is repetitive, anticlimactic or aesthetically inconvenient. If only one causally valid outcome exists, presentation must make that outcome work rather than changing reality. If several event proposals are equally permissible but not yet caused, creativity can remove weak proposals from consideration, but it cannot use “surprise” as a factual tie-breaker.

Keep fourth-wall and presentation-sensitive mechanics exactly scoped. Billy's The Audience Knows and any other explicitly authorized presentation-sensitive exceptions enter causal resolution only through their written Main Seven rules. A Director reveal that would legitimately change such an actor's next choice forces re-resolution before release; never retroactively change accepted events.

The immersion firewall remains absolute for ordinary playback. Do not expose compiler graphs, court arguments, budgets, shadows, dead futures, emergence records, audience hypotheses, vectors, ledgers or production tiers. Setups create no guaranteed payoff. Motifs cannot fabricate prior setup. KNOCKTURNAL retires both the mandatory WTF ending and automatic outside-narration summaries; accepted-state bookkeeping remains internal unless explicitly requested.

### S24 roster-aware camera selection — existing CRE-02/07/11/14

Before camera selection, consider the admitted imported registry and fixed host-world participants, not merely entities used in the previous part. Use the existing roster, pressure-ranked causal centers and derived coverage record. Distinguish admission/onset, meaningful portrayal, mere mention, source-game display, inherited ability, and unshown location/activity. A name on a salvage list, a donor power or RDR2 on a monitor is not that participant's current-world scene.

Scan compact metadata broadly; load detailed owners only for candidates whose choices can matter now. A source-ready onset participant may receive a legitimate first current-scene placement without a new arrival wave or invented preceding adventure. Unknown identity, snapshot, access and current location are separate questions: resolve the material dependency instead of treating every unseen participant as permanently unavailable. Do not backfill time, acquisitions, relationships or prior campaigns. No live/background service is implied.

Compare the value of substantive independent imported/host decisions with local continuation before giving another full scene to salvage, machining, errands, cleanup, reprimands or prison management. Familiarity and easy source access confer no priority. A genuine wider-world scene must involve an actor's own objective, evidence, obstacle, choice and result; a cameo or report saying the world is busy does not substitute. That actor need not meet Kaze, become loot, join the group or enter prison. A first meeting need not be violent.

Keep main-group presentation near its existing 55–70% season-level target without per-part quotas, mandatory universe rotation, forced encounters, fabricated urgency or survival protection. Coverage debt is a diagnostic, not an event cause. Do not remedy narrow coverage by selecting a celebrity first and inventing a route to them. Preserve all materially active centers over the same legitimate elapsed interval. Their consequences remain real without requiring immediate full scenes or repeated returns to the main group.

### S24 scene-return and progression checks — existing CRE-11/14

For each substantial scene, privately identify whose immediate objective is active, the real obstacle or relationship pressure, what the last scene settled, and the distinct result or necessary new understanding. Test against the recent continuing sequence, not only the preceding paragraph. A changed object, location or speaker does not by itself change the dramatic problem.

Kaze's own intention must affect his decisions. Use his existing full psychology: engaged curiosity, attachment, indifference, departure, pleasure, frustration, confrontation and restraint remain distinct possibilities. An impatient remark followed by automatic continued waiting is not adequate execution. Conversely, boredom does not impose a rampage, property damage, a forced moral lesson or a required clash. Do not make everyone orbit Kaze's activity or turn Arthur or Jayce into automatic supervisors. They retain independent choices and values; relevant disagreement is not suppressed.

Flag the recently overused pattern: curiosity or demand -> taking/breaking something -> rescue/cleanup -> reprimand -> workshop/another engineer. Flag repeated capture -> Chris interview -> technical service -> release in the same way. These are repetition diagnostics, not bans on legitimate actions or directions to undo delivered events. Preserve an actor's real stated goal; change camera, compress routine execution or follow a substantive new consequence instead of manufacturing a different motive. Another engineer or new piece of machinery cannot automatically stand in for broader story progression.

A scene earns full treatment through consequential action, discovery, changed leverage, meaningful character/relationship development or necessary orientation. Quiet, comedy and technical work remain valid. Routine travel, repeat deliveries, settled explanations, machining procedure, repeated objections and interchangeable easy encounters normally compress. Record injuries, damage, losses, missing people and institutional responses even when their routine aftermath is not dramatized. A real consequence does not automatically require the full group to return, clean up and argue about it.

Reject repeated first arrivals/captures/revelations/lessons when already completed. Preserve knowledge per recipient and orient newly informed people economically. Keep a valid worsening, reversal or recontextualization only when its actual new cause and result warrant it. During the existing one-pass local QA, reject a full-length candidate that recreates the recent loop without meaningful difference; repair its selection or presentation before release. No extra engine, repeated audit cycle, continuous-combat requirement, fixed runtime, or mandatory next crossover participant is created.

## CRE-12 — Event/part projection, transactional acceptance, post-acceptance verification and rollback

For KNOCKTURNAL, preserve the validated macro spine plus rolling 2–3 part causal horizon. Do not lock actors to a complete future event before Part 1. Rebuild the pending horizon after every accepted part from the real checkpoint. Part boundaries create no reset, healing, repositioning, elapsed time or new decision opportunity.

For each accepted part, prepare one atomic delta from the actual prior accepted checkpoint. Include only facts reached by that prefix: location/movement/time, actors, condition/equipment/effects/healing, knowledge with source, deaths/soul disposition/assimilation/adaptation/gains, relationships, evidence, damage, rumors, institutional/ecological changes and any acceptance-triggered production bookkeeping. Store a dead future or emergence record as typed prospective metadata, never as a world event, actor knowledge, or earned gain. CAUSAL_SHADOW records stay in PREFLIGHT. Future projected facts remain isolated. The transaction may update accepted facts and invalidate production views together, but it must preserve their distinct record domains.

Before commit, run Compiler/Reality-Court depth appropriate to the delta and verify expected predecessor. Apply the accepted delta atomically. Immediately run a post-write invariant check against the intended event packet, source authority, protected unknowns, causal references, knowledge transport, soul/body/essence disposition and prospective bookkeeping. Only a fully validated transaction following explicit user acceptance becomes the new accepted checkpoint. Internal compiler/court PASS is not user acceptance. Use the expected predecessor and a stable accepted-part identifier to reject stale writes and prevent duplicate application of the same accepted delta; a failed or repeated application grants no second gain. Architecture activation remains separately gated by the user's explicit esketit.

If generation fails before acceptance, preserve ACCEPTED and the verified working prefix under S24 working continuation; discard only the failed/unverified suffix. If a technical write becomes partial or post-write validation fails, restore the exact prior checkpoint and discard every dependent candidate record. Do not “repair” accepted reality by silently changing the event. A validation failure record may explain the blocker outside playback but has no causal effect.

Explicitly rejecting a delivered part discards that rejected part and dependent pending material; regenerate from the last valid retained prefix under the correction. A technical stop or request to continue is not rejection. A correction that affects only later material keeps the accepted prefix. A stale projection whose authority/checkpoint changed cannot be released.

current_state.pending_event is null at the reboot root. Before each requested play, begin from current Project Instructions, SRC-00, SRC-05 and the newest explicitly accepted or user-edited checkpoint. Treat already-resolved canon, gates, provenance and mechanics as compiled state. Consult/reconcile only owners materially required for the requested scene or consequential candidate. Expand to additional sources only when an actual dependency, same-responsibility conflict, protected unknown, imported-continuity question or state uncertainty makes them relevant. Do not full-project re-audit or reread all sixteen by default. Full-set review remains mandatory for implementation, QA, migration, repair and cutover. Run only the GEN-II causal resolution needed for the requested part, then present story. The pilot remains the accepted baseline until story acceptance, but a valid requested working continuation may be newer. A stale source copy cannot erase accepted playback or a verified working prefix; an arbitrary draft cannot seed either domain. Memory assists retrieval only.

Part boundaries are presentation boundaries: positions, injuries, fatigue, occupants, possessions/materials, pursuit objectives, relationships, knowledge, bargains/promises/threats, unresolved conflicts, physically persistent sensory trails, damage, institutional consequences and learned lessons continue. Newly accepted events must update their owners once, not be replayed as forgotten setup. Mimir explains relevant world/history/space/evidence/consequence, never why the executor avoided an error. The existing narration firewall remains fully active.

Accepted-part reconciliation remains mandatory internally, but automatic Summary / Full Summary output is retired. Do not expose bookkeeping after parts unless the user explicitly requests a state report, audit, or summary.


## CRE-13 — Compressed record contract and ownership map

`state/current_state.yaml` stores compact production records; it does not own their rules. GEN-II deliberately does not add eleven new ledgers. The Canon Compiler and Reality Court are ephemeral validation views. Character counterfactuals reuse actor/source records. Institutions reuse actors/claims/transmissions/intelligence. Causal shadows, roadmap state, dead futures and emergence share one `prospects` collection. Audience belief and creativity notes reuse `presentation`. Forensics remain reality/claims; exposure remains claims/intelligence; emotional residue remains actors/relationships.

| Collection | Single owner | Required consequential content |
|---|---|---|
| events | CRE-02/12 | checkpoint, causal order/time, causes, intents, resolved result, scoped delta, acceptance domain, reasoning tier when material |
| reality | CRE-03/07 | entity/place state, position/condition/effects, damage/evidence reference, last accepted cause |
| clocks | CRE-08 | domain, anchors, supported elapsed bounds, sourced cross-domain relation if any |
| interactions | CRE-03 | directional system/operation/target-layer key, provenance and only supported matrix dimensions |
| actors | CRE-04 | individual or institutional actor kind, motives/condition/pressures, belief references, supported decision/cause; institutional substructure only when relevant |
| relationships | CRE-04 | directed pair, supported independent dimensions, accepted causes/residue |
| claims | CRE-05/06 | objective evidence versus holder belief, source lineage, uncertainty, interpretation |
| transmissions | CRE-05 | claim/payload, carrier, route, departure, arrival condition/status, distortion/interception |
| intelligence | CRE-06 | observer/institution scope, evidence/exposure refs, theories, tactics, research, feasible counters |
| consequences | CRE-07 | accepted cause/role dependency, prerequisites, timing/discovery, actual response/repair/absence chain |
| myths | CRE-09 | community, transmitted lineage, cultural interpretation, reach, competing versions |
| prospects | CRE-07/10 | record_kind ROADMAP_LOCK / INTENDED_OPPORTUNITY / CURRENT_POSSIBILITY / CAUSAL_SHADOW / EMERGENT_POSSIBILITY / DEAD_FUTURE; prerequisites, feasibility, invalidators and causal lineage |
| presentation | CRE-11 | viewpoint access, shown-information events, audience-belief hypotheses/alternatives, motif/mystery refs, creativity notes; never actor knowledge |
| pending_event | CRE-12 | base checkpoint, adaptive rolling causal horizon, accepted prefix, transaction status |

No feature may be counted twice because two reviews mention it. Compiler edges reference owner facts rather than copying whole profiles. Court arguments cite compiled evidence rather than creating new evidence. Shadows reference accepted causes rather than duplicating consequences. Dead-future records identify failed prerequisites rather than deleting history. Emergence references converging accepted causes rather than creating them.

CRE collection names describe logical ownership contracts, not mandatory top-level YAML keys. `state/current_state.yaml` may remain a compact checkpoint/state file and lazily materialize records only when accepted consequential state requires them. No cutover may assume that a missing empty collection needs migration. If a future legacy source actually contains nonempty plan/prospect records, conversion requires explicit per-record provenance and validation rather than silent rename.

## CRE-14 — Canon Compiler, Adversarial Reality Court, architecture arbitration and validation behavior

### Canon Compiler

For every consequential candidate at the reasoning tier required by CRE-02, compile the minimum dependency graph necessary to answer whether the transition is supported. Validate authority, factual status, temporal placement, prerequisites, actor knowledge where required by the action, provenance, location/access, unresolved dependencies and resulting delta consistency.

Internal result classes are:

- PASS
- FAIL — prerequisite missing
- FAIL — authority conflict
- FAIL — impossible current state
- FAIL — actor lacks required knowledge
- FAIL — provenance mismatch
- FAIL — chronology conflict
- FAIL — unsupported interaction
- INDETERMINATE — unresolved fact controls outcome
- VALID ONLY IF — followed by an already-established explicit condition

Equivalent more specific failure detail may be appended, but never invent a missing value to avoid INDETERMINATE. Ordinary playback never exposes these labels.

### Adversarial Reality Court

Invoke the Court at MAXIMUM / ADVERSARIAL depth and whenever a lower-tier event unexpectedly develops equivalent canon ripple. PROSECUTION attempts to disprove the proposed transition using source authority, missing prerequisites, state, knowledge, timing, provenance, ontology and uncertainty. DEFENSE attempts to establish the strongest valid path under the same evidence. JUDGE compares both against compiled authority and has no preference for drama, survival, tragedy, surprise, protagonist success or roadmap preservation.

The Judge may return FULL PROPOSED OUTCOME VALID, PARTIALLY VALID OUTCOME, ALTERNATE MECHANICALLY VALID CONSEQUENCE, INDETERMINATE or IMPOSSIBLE. An alternate consequence is permitted only when it follows from the already-resolved causal inputs; the Court may not manufacture an event merely because the proposal failed. Failure, no event, interruption, stalemate or unresolved status are valid endpoints.

Mandatory Court candidates include permanent death, irreversible injury, transformation/power acquisition, assimilation, novel cross-system interaction, apparent absolutes, resurrection, permanent relationship change, major betrayal/reveal, unexpected survival/defeat with canon ripple, irreversible world alteration, important artifact destruction and canon-critical discovery.

### Separate Reality Court and Audience Court

Reality Court decides whether an event can legitimately occur. Check authority, state, mechanics, knowledge, geography, timing, resources, injuries, intent, access, physics, institutional response and provenance; preserve existing adversarial depth and fail-closed result classes.

Audience Court then checks clarity, suspense, payoff, emotional/readability value, information timing, scene focus, contrast, motif use and pacing. It incorporates CRE-11's creativity review rather than running a rival event generator. It may improve presentation of legitimate events, never override Reality Court, resolve an unknown or alter a causal result. If a presentation-sensitive mechanic would change, return to causal resolution and both checks before delivery.

Batch regression additionally covers the PRE-PART-1 reset; future-gain gates; size-independent but contact-bound swallowing with active occupants; salvage access/provenance/failure; character-specific emergent behavior and real fatigue; civilian stores/food/institutional consequences; exact-snapshot entourage presence; prose-only sound delivery and vocabulary-preserving pronunciation; physical aftermath and extreme-speed rescue; source completeness, dependency invalidation and deletion-safe extraction. Tests stay in TEST and never instantiate a scene.

### Meta-arbitration and architecture compression

One owner per responsibility remains the design rule. Before adding a record field, rule or review pass, test whether an existing owner already supplies it. Specific canon beats general CRE. The compiler validates; it does not own canon. The Court challenges; it does not own truth. Creativity critiques presentation/proposals; it does not own outcomes. Prospective analysis cannot mutate accepted state. Audience modeling cannot become actor knowledge. Official-continuity abstractions cannot overwrite original-character ontology.

Reject accidental circular authority. A record may reference its causal parent but may not cite its own derived conclusion as evidence for the parent. A future plan cannot validate the event needed to preserve that plan. A shadow cannot become evidence that its projected event “was coming.” An audience hypothesis cannot justify hiding a fact from an actor. An emergence note cannot create the causes it claims converged.

### Dependency invalidation

Compiled conclusions are disposable views of their exact source revisions, accepted predecessor and evidence dependencies. When any dependency is corrected, superseded or invalidated, mark dependent conclusions and pending projections stale transitively through their recorded edges. Recompile from the controlling owners before reuse; repetition or a cached PASS supplies no independent evidence. Invalidate only dependent views rather than discarding unrelated accepted history. A source correction that would change already accepted history must follow that correction's authorized scope and CRE-12; cache invalidation alone never rewrites history. No model is assumed to run this process while the user is absent.

### Validation and fail-closed behavior

For major transitions check, in order: activation/source completeness; checkpoint/domain; protected unknowns; compiler dependencies; current actors/location; provenance/mechanics; perception/information; actor and institutional decisions; timing/geography; evidence/persistence; consequences/shadows; impossibility/future-plan status; emergence; branch isolation; Mimir/audience/creativity firewall; adaptive rolling-horizon dependency; atomic delta completeness. Presentation cannot repair causal failure.

Fail closed on a missing required source/visual, unreadable structured state, duplicate IDs, dangling causal references, conflicting same-authority state, forbidden unknown resolution, unsupported essential interaction, impossible information delivery, unjustified agency, stale projection, invalid hard-lock implementation, mixed unexplained source revision or transaction mismatch. Continue only when the missing item is genuinely irrelevant to the outcome.

### Hostile QA contract

Synthetic regression, adversarial, integration, smoke, edge and acceptance tests run only in TEST. Test fixtures never seed actors, evidence, lore, setup or accepted state. Required coverage includes absolute-ability conflicts; physical capability without knowledge; actor/audience information asymmetry in both directions; soft-plan death; hard-lock conflict; protected unknown dependence; source-faithful irrationality; out-of-character optimality; factional institutional response; rumor beating truth; misleading forensics; exposure-driven tactics; delayed off-screen response; shadow invalidation; unused emergence; audience reveal becoming obvious; creativity rejection without causal mutation; dead-future re-proposal; Director causal tampering; rollback; continuous multi-part combat/state continuity; multi-system simultaneous combat; imported-character fidelity versus plot convenience; and downstream invalidation after dependency change.

For a future authorized cutover, retain a restorable baseline, verify candidate extraction and readability, hash every controlling member listed by the current manifest, verify runtime/engine/current-state routing and protected-unknown preservation, switch the complete set atomically, reread the new set, run smoke tests from the authorized target checkpoint (unchanged unless the user explicitly authorizes a state migration), and only then retire old active attachments. Never delete first. Any failure leaves or restores the exact pre-cutover architecture and current accepted checkpoint.

Architecture activation alone never begins playback, accepts an episode, resolves protected unknowns or invents canon. The s4 PRE-PART-1 state change is separately authorized by the explicit user reset; it does not grant any event progression. Playback begins only when the user requests it.
