All mutable updates still belong to state/current_state.yaml. Derived views are indexes and diagnostics, never separate ledgers or authority.

### CRE-02/13 retrieval and world index
Use hash-valid HOT_RUNTIME.selected_playback_state after the required bootstrap. derived/WORLD_INDEX.yaml supplies all admitted registry rows, expanded member identities, fixed native groups and external systems plus last-established centers. Demand-load event/roster.yaml for an identity/snapshot/group ambiguity and accepted_events.jsonl for exact replay/evidence recovery. They are no longer unconditional ordinary PLAY payloads. Metadata scan does not instantiate bodies or grant knowledge. Before camera selection advance all materially established centers over the same supported interval; unknown remote timing/positions stay unknown. A center is not a predetermined next scene. derived/OWNER_SECTIONS.yaml may retrieve bounded owner excerpts only when full material constraints and combination dependencies are closed; full owner load is required if that closure is uncertain.

### CRE-05/07/12/13 recovery and compact state
derived/STATE_VIEWS.yaml losslessly references shared evidence with recipient-specific interpretations; compression cannot add recipients. Use typed resource availability only for material finite dependencies; unknown means neither infinite nor empty. Preserve small causal possessions, injuries, clips, ammunition use, promises, custody and environmental/institutional residue. Relationship records remain directional, qualitative and evidence-bound. Obligation statuses OPEN, DORMANT, BLOCKED, RESOLVED, SUPERSEDED and IRRELEVANT-BECAUSE-DEPENDENCY-ENDED require actual closure causes; closed records remain in evidence but leave hot attention. Consequential delivered working events use stable event IDs, evidence/message or passage anchors where available, predecessor edges, state delta, status and correction lineage under pending_event. Missing original prose or anchors remain explicitly unavailable. A correction removes only its dependency closure; removing a release never fabricates recapture.

### CRE-04/11/14 diagnostic enforcement
Use existing actor decision checks for independent wants, incentive-based cooperation, legitimate knowledge and counterfactual absence of Kaze/planned destinations/fame. Full-toolkit tests route all current function families and conditional combinations, never a move rotation. Development-debt review flags repeated relevant pressure without consequential choice; it does not force growth. Presentation-side audience orientation, comedy variation, long-horizon structure, conflict-origin distribution and independent-world delivery records require actually shown/resolved evidence. Unknown counts stay unknown; there are no quotas, mandatory cameos or fabricated autonomous developments.

### CRE-11/14 post-render listening and diagnostics
Run one local TTS/readability check after rendering: referents, speaker changes, noun density, long sentences, fragment ladders, visual dependence, simultaneous transitions, acronyms/weapon labels, location handoffs and dense paragraphs. Repair wording/attribution only. Any causal change returns to the existing causal check. Structured diagnostics distinguish PASS, FAIL, INDETERMINATE and NOT_MEASURED, identify source/state hashes, loaded modules/bytes, open dependencies, owner loads, center candidates/camera rationale, correction closure and unknown blockers. Measure retrieval, preflight, render and total separately; no render test is claimed when playback is forbidden. Deeper audit escalation requires an actual conflict; all diagnostics stay outside PLAY.


## S27 anti-novelty-conveyor execution — existing CRE-06/07/11/14

Scoped execution refinement; no new CRE module, actor trait, power, aggression requirement or story event.

**NO_GUARANTEED_CURIOSITY_PAYOFF** — Investigation may yield partial information, dead ends, mundane explanations, unresolved evidence or nothing actionable. Curiosity creates no obligation to supply an encounter, artifact, lead, mystery, target or destination.

**NO_CLUE_DAISY_CHAINS** — A meaningful encounter does not automatically point to another. Information may terminate; useful discoveries need not create follow-up quests.

**EVIDENCE_FIRST_GEOGRAPHY** — Never invent a foreign structure, seam, wreck, facility, trail, settlement, landmark or displaced geography primarily to supply a scene/reveal. Require established world/displacement evidence or legitimate native geography; roster admission and thematic plausibility are not evidence.

**ENCOUNTER_INDEPENDENCE** — Roster membership does not make an actor locally available. Require independently valid position, travel, motive, information, pursuit or chance intersection supported by world state. Do not select an interesting actor and then manufacture access.

**STRUCTURAL_REPETITION_CHECK** — Compare scene function and causal dependency shape across recent relevant scenes: trigger, objective, obstacle, information reward, consequence and handoff. A workshop loop reskinned as a mystery loop remains repetition. Changed names, locations, powers or objects are not a substantive difference.

**INTERACTION_SATURATION** — After the principal new information, relationship change, conflict or consequence is delivered, compress continuing travel/banter unless something materially changes. Successful chemistry alone does not justify extension. Doctor Kaze/science humor has paid off; future uses must be sparse and contextual.

**ESTABLISHED_CHARACTERIZATION_COMPRESSION** — Do not repeatedly prove settled behavior. Light's caution, Chris/Jayce iterative engineering, Arthur's future-knowledge restraint and Kaze's autonomy recur in full only when challenged or producing a new consequence; compression never rewrites these traits.

**ORDINARY_INTERVALS_VALID** — Travel, meals, rest, exploration, work, socializing, boredom and ordinary existence need no champion, attack, mystery, artifact, revelation or quest. Compress uneventful intervals when appropriate; do not invent pressure to satisfy a scene-value test.

**CAMERA_PRESSURE_OVER_PROTAGONIST_MOMENTUM** — Following a lead does not reserve Kaze's camera time. Compare substantive independent causal centers; a more consequential center may take presentation priority while Kaze continues off-camera through the same legitimate interval.

**INDEPENDENT_PRESSURE_MAY_FIND_KAZE** — When supported, allow already-moving witnesses, Ferros investigation, institutional reports, enemies, survivors, reputation and political responses to reach Kaze. He need not discover every development. This is permission for established causality, never a substitute encounter quota.

**NO_REPLACEMENT_FORMULA** — Apply function-level repetition detection recursively to any newly dominant pattern. Blocking one loop does not authorize a themed replacement, forced dead ends, compulsory interruptions or compulsory violence. Preserve legitimate outcomes; repair presentation or select an independently eligible center, not reality for novelty.

## S27 causal latency and combat timing — existing CRE-02/03/04/05/06/07/08/14

Scoped execution refinement; no new CRE module, actor trait, power, aggression requirement or story event.

**NO_CONSEQUENCE_BANKING** — Once an event creates an actionable consequence, propagation begins immediately through valid routes. Do not hold it for a later episode or clean scene boundary.

**PHYSICAL_REACTION_TIME** — Resolve perception -> comprehension -> decision -> action using actual distance, speed, communication, readiness, psychology, command structure, injuries, equipment and access. No artificial dramatic delay; no fabricated numerical precision.

**THREATS_INTERRUPT_SCENES** — A legitimately arriving threat or consequence interrupts conversation, meals, investigation, engineering, travel, rest and exposition at its actual arrival. No camera center has scene protection.

**CONFLICT_THRESHOLDS_EXECUTE** — When the established threshold for attack, arrest, escape, pursuit, retaliation, capture, betrayal or intervention is crossed and action is feasible, execute the actor's actual decision. Do not repeatedly restate hostility before action.

**NO_REPEATED_WARNING_PHASE** — An already-established warning, condition, threat assessment or response decision need not be repeated. The next qualifying violation may trigger response directly; knowledge and actor psychology still govern.

**NO_COMBAT_WARMUP_REQUIREMENT** — Stare-downs, introductory dialogue, weak opening attacks, testing phases, transformation ladders, reciprocal exchanges and delayed finishing moves are optional only when the actual actor would choose them. There is no mandatory combat sequence.

**COMBAT_TIME_NOT_PROSE_TIME** — Detailed narration may cover seconds, but every depicted action and spoken line must fit those seconds under established mechanics. Narration length never grants speech, extra reactions or turn-based time.

**SIMULTANEOUS_ACTION** — Actors, projectiles, allies, hazards, defenses and interference may overlap. Resolve event ordering, dependency and valid concurrency rather than serial character turns unless mechanics require serial action.

**DECISIVE_MISMATCHES_RESOLVE_FAST** — When intent, knowledge, speed, power, position and mechanics establish an overwhelming mismatch, resolve at their actual implied speed. Fame, future usefulness and coverage debt grant no combat-duration floor, survival or inverse plot armor.

**ESCAPE_AT_SURVIVAL_THRESHOLD** — Fleeing, hiding, cover, calls for aid, repositioning, surrender and disengagement begin when actual psychology and perceived circumstances require them. Do not wait for another attack to extend a scene; resolve actual routes and interception.

**PURSUIT_ON_VALID_ROUTE** — A committed pursuer acts once sufficient motive, information, capability and access exist. Delay requires a real cause such as preparation, uncertainty, injury, resource need or competing objective; commitment does not bypass travel or unknown location.

**INJURIES_APPLY_IMMEDIATELY** — From onset, blood loss, pain, limb damage, sensory impairment, shock, equipment loss, fear and mobility loss affect behavior. Regeneration and tactical adaptation also begin at their legitimate onset/rate; no reset between exchanges.

**WITNESSES_REACT_IMMEDIATELY** — Witnesses may flee, hide, protect others, alarm, report, record, intervene, lock access, seek reinforcement or do nothing according to capability and psychology. Their opportunity to react is not deferred until narration needs a report.

**DISTRIBUTED_INSTITUTIONAL_RESPONSE** — Nearby guards, officers, medics, commanders, workers and civilians can react within actual authority before central command knows everything. Preserve command/communication limits without freezing local action.

**FAST_INFORMATION_NOT_OMNISCIENCE** — Information uses the fastest actually available route with its real payload and recipients. A witness/patrol/commander chain may be rapid while Piltover-to-distant-Noxus is slower. Never slow a valid route to protect a scene or invent awareness/access/carriers.

**CONSEQUENCES_COLLIDE_MID_PLAN** — Existing investigations, retaliation, pursuit and political/military responses can arrive during another plan. Subplots do not wait for one another's presentation to finish.

**COMPRESS_LATENCY_NOT_CAUSALITY** — If a response takes forty minutes and nothing material intervenes, compress that interval rather than spending several PLAY outputs waiting. Advance all material centers through the same interval; preserve arrivals or decisions within it. Never shorten actual travel, recovery or transmission time.

**NO_CONFLICT_PRESERVATION** — Death, escape, surrender, capture, disengagement or objective completion ends the encounter when causally resolved. Do not preserve unresolved hostility for a future rivalry. Any later conflict needs its own remaining/new legitimate cause; no forced reconciliation.

**FASTER_REALISM_NOT_MORE_VIOLENCE** — Remove artificial delay only. Do not manufacture aggression, awareness, access, evidence, courage, manpower or motive. Real hesitation, uncertainty, bureaucracy, travel, fear, recovery, caution and restraint remain. Non-hostile coexistence and quiet are valid.

**SILENT_MICRO_TIMELINE** — Before rendering a consequential event, resolve a local partial timeline: onset, immediate reactions, overlapping actions, nearby response, report/command propagation, injuries, exits and resolution. Use exact timestamps only when material and supported. Pending prerequisites stay pending; render results, never production timeline/QA.

## S27 evidence-bounded local suffix repair — existing CRE-01/12/14

After this explicit s33 reboot, local repairs preserve its own verified valid prefix and independent causal centers. Discarded-route checkpoints are historical only. Never reselect their provisional frontier or infer missing dialogue/micropositions. Explicit new corrections can change only their stated scope; rejected prose and dependent facts remain excluded. WORK never advances time.

## S28 execution reliability — existing CRE-01/02/03/07/08/11/12/13/14

Committed by explicit user ESKETIT after the five scoped reliability recommendations. This implements existing responsibilities; it creates no CRE module, character trait, power, encounter, elapsed time or accepted event. Only a real PLAY request may execute production story. Synthetic tests remain TEST.

### S28 semantic projection contracts

A current source hash proves input identity, not correct interpretation. Derived state must also satisfy the explicit projections in EXECUTION_INDEX.reliability_contracts.semantic_projections. Direct mirrors copy their complete designated object, including qualifiers and unknown markers. Selected transforms declare their source paths, transformation and output type; they cannot silently omit newer suffix facts. A lossy narrative summary is labeled as such and references its source; it is never treated as a lossless mirror. No view can promote source status or transform unrecorded into absent.

Regeneration evaluates the declared projection dependency graph in topological order, reading newly rebuilt upstream values, then verifies complete mapped parity before advertising fresh hashes. Reject cycles, conflicting/overlapping target ownership, undeclared transforms and malformed JSON pointers; array indexes are nonnegative canonical indexes, not Python negative-index shortcuts. Include a mutation test that changes one owner fact while retaining a seemingly fresh cache hash: the semantic test must reject the stale value. Compare complete mapped objects rather than hand-selecting convenient fields. Hash-valid but semantically invalid views are unusable for the dependent decision; recover from their owners and repair only the affected closure. Unmapped descriptive fields remain bounded summaries, not implicitly certified translations. Extend mappings when a new derived field begins controlling selection or continuity.

Ordinary PLAY checks only materially used projections and their dependencies within existing local QA. Full mapping verification belongs to implementation/cutover. Projection data comes from the selected reboot current_state only. Archived encounters are not active coverage; explicit earlier-history choices are listed in current_state.history_policy. View regeneration changes no story.

### S28 sequence-level repetition decisions

Use the existing presentation record for evidence-linked recent beat functions: trigger, active objective, obstacle, information role, consequential change, closure/handoff and resolved dramatic question. Compare the continuing relevant sequence, including interrupted/resumed patterns and replacement loops, not only adjacent prose. Do not manufacture retrospective annotations for missing text. A source-supported summary can identify a known pattern without pretending to supply every missing beat or count.

New information, a new prop or a boolean new_consequence flag never grants automatic full-scene admission. Distinguish information that merely supplies another stop in the same pursuit from information that materially changes supported options, stakes, commitment, relationship, outcome or closes/recontextualizes the actual question. Each claimed difference needs its actual cause/evidence and an explanation of what changes beyond the next clue. A new question manufactured solely to extend the chain is not closure. Surface vocabulary is not the comparator.

When the same causal structure dominates without a material distinction, compress valid repeated activity, end saturated presentation or choose another independently eligible center. Preserve events already resolved by agency/reality. A finite investigation or repeated real task can legitimately continue; its actual developments and necessary orientation determine detail. No automatic quota, novelty score, forced failure, mystery, interruption, aggression, camera rotation or universal ban on recurring forms. Quiet remains legal, and an unchanged faithful choice can be compressed without forcing character growth.

Maintain this through the single existing CRE-11/14 pass. Evaluation result is DETAIL_ELIGIBLE, COMPRESS_OR_END, or INDETERMINATE_PENDING_EVIDENCE; eligibility is permission, never a command to dramatize. Incomplete evidence does not force repetition or invent novelty. Reference scripts test supplied semantic annotations; they cannot certify that free prose was annotated correctly.

### S28 actions in progress and interruption boundaries

For materially ongoing actions, recover a sparse record within the selected state domain using the existing events/actors/consequences/clocks responsibilities: stable action ID, actor and intent, source/predecessor, causal start anchor, progress actually reached, enabling prerequisites, completion condition, established timing bounds or partial order, relevant resource/effect commitments, known incoming interference and current status. Suggested statuses are PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, PAUSED, INTERRUPTED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and UNRESOLVED. They are descriptions, not a mandatory lifecycle or permission to manufacture action. An absent record is unrecorded, never proof that an action began, stopped or finished.

Resolve up to the next materially relevant change that can affect the action, including concurrent effects. An arriving report, injury, obstruction, departure or loss of access may change only those preconditions it actually affects. Revalidate the unexecuted dependent suffix from that point. Actor psychology and mechanics decide whether to continue, adapt, pause, cancel, flee or do nothing; interruption is not automatic cancellation. Preserve completed portions, spent resources and effects unless an established mechanic reverses them. Do not finish the old plan first or repeat its executed prefix.

Physical changes can affect an actor without their awareness; decision changes from a report require actual receipt/comprehension. Effects already launched may continue independently after their initiator is interrupted. Simultaneous actors, hazards and projectiles keep their own valid dependencies. A boundary or camera cut grants no new time, healing, reset or turn. When ordering overlaps unresolved bounds and changes the outcome, retain all feasible first-arrival candidates and leave their relative order unresolved; do not sort lower bounds into a fabricated actual order. A previously invalidated action also invalidates its unexecuted dependents. Known independent timing facts remain usable even when another route is unknown. Known relative order can resolve an outcome without exact timestamps.

Pending processes carry actual due conditions and invalidators, not scheduled plot appointments. Advance only through legitimate story intervals, never user absence, file dates or TTS duration. Compression stops for an intervening material event; a forty-minute wait cannot swallow an event due within it. No global resimulation or all-roster polling per sentence: re-evaluate affected dependencies and consider independent centers through the existing world/camera pass. WORK/QA creates no production action records from hypothetical examples.

### S28 generated-output evidence and testing

Keep four separately reported layers: source/package integrity; contract-model behavior; observed generated-output compliance; editorial quality. Passing one never proves another. Actual generation cases retain exact input sources/hashes, fixture and sequence IDs, supplied context, generator identity as actually exposed, isolation method, prompts, outputs, per-step state/evidence traces and review findings. Do not guess the model build. Mark same-session guided samples as SAME_SESSION_GUIDED, not fresh-context or independent evidence.

For an available fresh generator, start each fixture from an isolated TEST checkpoint loaded through manifest/runtime/index/material owners, with no production conversation or saved story state injected except explicitly enumerated test inputs. Preserve each fixture's connected sequence across turns. Test clue chains with fresh information, uneventful travel, interruption, fast mismatch, local correction with independent support, and exact continuation after a technical stop. Include invalid variants and mutation checks. Annotate actual output, never substitute the expected answer as an observed response. Measure outcomes from supported events and communication order; no invented precision.

Record NOT_RUN or NOT_MEASURED when no suitable generator, render, independent evaluator or timing instrumentation is available. A ready harness is not an executed model test. Synthetic input numbers are fixture facts only. Same-session samples may demonstrate bounded compliance but cannot certify fresh-context reliability, characterize future PLAY or establish real runtime latency. Tests and reports stay outside the sixteen controlling files. A reported generation failure requires local correction and an affected-case repass; do not reroll until a preferred story outcome appears. Failures caused by genuinely unresolved canon retain the dependent block.

### S28 exact continuation evidence preservation

Strengthen CRE-12's existing pending_event contract without accepting story. When a writable surface exists, preserve the exact verified delivered text or an exact source anchor plus its UTF-8 digest, selected predecessor/domain, stable event IDs, reached state delta, causal order, last completed action, actions genuinely still in progress and precise unfinished step. Store this through existing evidence/journal owners; derived views reference it. No second mutable canon ledger. Preserve prior verified delivery text/anchors and reached deltas through an append-only operation history or equivalent immutable evidence references; updating the latest cursor must not replace the only earlier exact evidence with hashes. Each stable event is applied once across operation IDs as well as within one operation. Archives remain evidence, never competing active checkpoints.

Prepare output as a draft, then mark only the delivered/verified prefix as eligible continuation evidence. A file written before delivery, unsent suffix or server-side generated completion is not automatically user-delivered text. If streaming delivery is uncertain, retain the draft and the last verified boundary separately. Do not promote the uncertain suffix or erase the verified prefix. Technical interruption is not rejection. Reconciliation may recover a later verified conversation endpoint without replaying it.

Evidence classes are VERIFIED_EXACT_TEXT, VERIFIED_SOURCE_ANCHOR, USER_CONFIRMED_SUMMARY, RETRIEVAL_SUMMARY and UNAVAILABLE, each with scope and provenance. A digest of a summary authenticates only that summary, not the original scene. Retrieval returning the word verbatim without the original passage does not upgrade its class. Preserve exact transcript gaps, variant ambiguity and last-observation qualifiers. Newest explicit user correction remains controlling for its supplied facts.

Checkpoint persistence uses an expected predecessor, stable operation ID, payload/evidence digests, validated prior evidence, temporary write and atomic replacement when supported. Concurrent cooperating writers require a surface-supported lock or conditional versioned write; a check followed by an unguarded replacement is not compare-and-swap. If replacement succeeded but durability confirmation failed, report that distinct status and reconcile the actual file before retrying; do not falsely report unchanged state or a fully confirmed save. Reject stale, conflicting or duplicate applications; identical retried delivery may be acknowledged without adding a second event. If no writable surface or write fails, preserve available conversation evidence and disclose the persistence limit outside PLAY when relevant; never claim a successful save. Explicit story acceptance alone promotes the exact verified provisional prefix under existing CRE-12 rules.

Recover missing evidence before materially dependent use, prioritizing the active continuation and causally relevant profiles. Public franchise research can establish source lore but cannot reconstruct private missing dialogue or choose an unprovided variant; this reboot expressly pins its earlier Hulk encounter to classic Savage #181. Exact snapshot gaps require project authority. No blanket reread, new roster appearance, replacement encounter or reinterpretation of a missing record as absence is authorized.

## S30 AUTHOR CORRECTION AND VISUAL PRECEDENCE
The explicit current user batch approval authorizes source maintenance, not story acceptance. Form availability correction does not select a current form, invent training/encounters, replenish resources or change prior delivered events. Inherited provisional-state availability reads current character configuration; stale cached gates must be regenerated. The closed set of approved visual sources is `visuals/visual_manifest.yaml`; mechanics/availability are never taken from generated captions. Remove superseded active definitions at their owner and preserve their text only as cold provenance. Unapproved alignment/name/scale proposals and unseen popup/Work-only content cannot become defaults.


## S30 local material retrieval and deterministic projection contract

This is a scoped optimization within the existing authority layout. Current-state truth remains solely in current_state, accepted journal history remains append-only, and source ecology remains in the three existing Runeterra owners. A small selected packet is not a second mutable core. No full architecture migration or source-file split is authorized by this local improvement.

Ordinary retrieval: selected reboot boundary → current pressures → actual seed actors → material decision dependencies. EXECUTION_INDEX.material_closure_contract contains the recipes. For a regional event select its eight-question route, actual observers and carrier prerequisites; admit only a material stakeholder, jurisdiction, reachable resource or requested expert. Relationship edges remain cheaply visible; they do not provide knowledge, proximity, availability or a scheduled cameo. When a material uncertainty needs a full owner or deeper evidence, retrieve it. Otherwise leave unrelated dossiers cold.

S33 projections are declarative exact-copy selectors and deterministic directed indexes. HOT copies current checkpoint/playback/pending, clocks, character availability, native phases, romance toggle and delivery contract. STATE_VIEWS copies current_state. WORLD_INDEX copies roster/entities, source neighborhoods and current native/center state. PRESENTATION_MEMORY copies only new reboot delivery/orientation and prospective Act I. No old view or historical pending cursor is an input. Each view contains its full source-dependency map, recipe and payload fingerprint; hashing does not legitimize wrong content.

Rebuild changed owner dependencies transitively in dependency order; serialize/write only changed derived bytes. A local visual change ordinarily affects its owner and section index; a source entity relation affects its owner, entity index and world projection; a current event affects current-state-dependent views. Do not rerun unrelated source research. Hash validity and field projection equality are both required, including a content-corruption test where hashes alone match.

Use HOT, WARM, COOL or DORMANT attention (legacy HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW map to HOT/WARM/COOL) according to evidence of imminent consequences, active plans or stable activity. This controls retrieval detail, never existence, clock speed or simulation privilege. Promote on actual information/plan/threat/dependency/relationship changes; do not advance off-camera actions during WORK.

At substantial delivery boundaries preserve exact predecessor identity/hash, completed event frontier, unfinished action, simultaneous pressures, already-spent resources, injuries and legitimate knowledge, plus the uncommitted suffix. Append only genuinely delivered or explicitly corrected fact deltas within the selected provisional/accepted responsibility. A user summary may resolve facts without recovering a verbatim final line or total independent-event order. Mark those gaps and do not fabricate them. Accepted promotion remains CRE-12 only.


## S30 full-validation projection and ownership contract

The s33 accepted reboot root remains separately preserved; S34 reconciles existing delivered evidence into a provisional continuation without acceptance. Historical journal and original evidence stay immutable. Manifest checkpoint/playback selectors exactly project current_state. Null pending_event applies only before any selected delivery; revised VI.3 now supplies the selected pending domain. Journal history alone never selects playback.
Derived views require transitive source digests AND semantic parity. JOURNAL_INDEX keeps exact line offsets, byte lengths/digests and transaction identifiers; no missing predecessor is reconstructed. OWNER_SECTIONS hashes exact owner heading spans and requires materially enclosing context. WORLD_INDEX preserves every roster row/entity, all source snapshot qualifiers, directed incoming/outgoing edges and phase gates. Graph membership never proves knowledge, proximity or activation.
Readiness projects all 43 requested fidelity subjects plus bounded future gates from owners. It is not a new research claim. Current presentation memory starts with no reboot deliveries or orientation records. Unplayed objectives remain prospective; completed old-route events do not become current obligations or known occurrences.
Reject dependency cycles, stale pointers, corrupted offsets, semantic drift even with recomputed hashes, and disagreements across views. Rebuild content then hashes in dependency order. Optional external scripts reproduce these declarative rules; clean extraction has all controlling facts without requiring an app or script at playback.

## S30 coordinated living-world architecture — existing CRE-00 through CRE-14

This is one dependency-driven continuation loop, not eighteen independent engines or ledgers. The capability table binds each function to its existing owner and shared collection. Keep five always-available HOT functions as compact owner pointers plus the current material frontier; they do not load five encyclopedias or instantiate missing state. Warm records are disposable projections. Sparse mutable records are materialized under the selected current_state domain only by legitimate subsequent PLAY or explicit user correction, never this installation.

The loop asks what the supported moving world does next. Schedule active clocks/actions/transmissions by their real arrival conditions before selecting a camera. Every center uses the same legitimate interval; TTS, waiting, user time, file timestamps and camera absence add no interval. Bounded arrival windows that overlap remain partially ordered; an unknown duration cannot become a fabricated completion. New hazards may interrupt between scenes. Step17 resolves the selected action inside the same interval; it does not grant an extra private turn or count the interval twice.

Use source-supported persistent goals, plans and contingencies; missing priorities, subplans and boundaries stay UNKNOWN. An unresolved composite thread does not give every listed actor the same goal. Keep literal current-state observations distinct from source motive candidates. Distinguish objective evidence, held knowledge, private beliefs, public claims and uncertainty. A delivery exposes only its actual payload to its actual recipient, including reports that may be wrong; membership, partnership and shared territory confer no automatic knowledge.

Doctrine projects mission, command/authority, information style and resources from the specific institution's source records. Unknown thresholds, authority holders or operational plans stay protected. An Enforcer investigation, Firelight community response, Ferros asset response, Noxian military response, Black Rose covert action, chem-baron commercial conflict and Avengers allied response must use their own records, not a generic faction personality. Population and reputation effects reuse consequences/claims/myths; rumor, prices, displacement and shortages need real affected people, carriers and mechanisms. Compression does not fabricate counts or erase civilian interests.

Relationships are directional and multi-axis, without default neutral scores. Attraction or amusement may coexist with boundaries, anger, suspicion or loyalty. The 99% portrayal tendency never supplies consent. Reputation belongs to its actual holder/community; one view of Kaze is not a global flag. Exposure records retain witnessed effect, observation quality, interpretation, confidence and actual report recipients. Research cannot grant an enemy a perfect counter.

Collision prediction joins active pressures on shared actors, resources, territory or information route, then checks supported timing, route, access and dependencies. A possible intersection is not a realized event. On arrival re-evaluate the material connected component; it may amplify or dampen, converge, split, fail or resolve quietly. Check who benefits only among actors with knowledge, motive, access and capability. Resource diversion and opportunity costs persist even when no one exploits them. Triage attention changes detail, never existence or clock rate.

Identity keys distinguish conceptual actor, variant, historical persona, collective and active body. Caitlyn aliases resolve once. Vander is a historical/persona route to Warwick, not another body. Chris and Billy retain two identities/consciousnesses with one exterior body slot. Exact distinct crossover incarnations never merge by display name. Older display-name state is preserved with derived links rather than rewritten during configuration. Source-date/last-verified/conflict status are provenance, not a freshness guarantee or actor knowledge. Refresh only materially affected records; a deployment-critical uncertain fact expands retrieval.

The compiler diffs only changed selected-domain fields, preserves stable event/predecessor/actor IDs and exact evidence references, and retains unknowns and unfinished work. A verified prefix can become the next provisional boundary without accepting story. Require exact expected predecessor, unique event ID, before-value preconditions, payload hash, delivered-prefix receipt and atomic replacement. A retry of the same committed payload is idempotent; the same ID with different content fails. Save already-spent resources/knowledge/injuries exactly once. Keep unsent suffixes outside committed state, and never replace materially necessary exact prose with a summary. Accepted promotion remains exclusively CRE-12.

Before major independent decisions run the existing counterfactual motive check: remove Kaze from the context; a sourced independent reason must survive, or a real Kaze-caused dependency must justify the response. This does not suppress legitimate responses to him. Missing support leaves the affected decision unresolved; it does not create an alternate motive. All machinery stays outside Black Mimir narration.

## S31 MEANINGFUL PROGRESSION, CAMERA AND EPISODE ADMISSION

Full PLAY targets roughly 25–30 minutes Spruce TTS by selecting enough legitimate causal material, never by stretching travel, meals, paperwork, jokes, workshop routine, repeated flirting or status-only updates. Every substantial episode should materially alter at least one real dependency: decision, relationship, information, objective, injury, custody, access, resource, strategy, position, reputation or institutional response. Quiet is valid; low-delta repetition is compressed. A remote center earns substantial camera through objective → obstacle → decision/action → consequence, not merely “still watching/working/investigating.” When several valid pressures coexist, select the strongest material pressure rather than the easiest already-loaded local actors.

Kaze's free-time social motive is simple: **KAZE WANTS TO DO HOODRAT SHIT WITH HIS HOMIES.** This can create mischief, exploration, gambling, nightlife, reckless competitions, questionable spaces or trouble through actual opportunity. Every friend may join, refuse, leave, redirect or pursue their own business. If nobody joins, Kaze may go alone. Boredom alone creates neither compulsory destruction nor passivity.

## S31 RUNETERRA RESEARCH UTILIZATION / ENSEMBLE ACTIVATION

Completed League/Arcane research is causal infrastructure, not a post-hoc lore checker. Before camera selection, route actual event locality through researched motives, relationships, families, partners, factions, houses, institutions, employees/followers, ordinary communities, resources, territory/access, trade, information routes and consequence routes. Native and imported actors live independently; Kaze is not their activation key. Fixed roster meaningful-viewpoint obligations are season-level and causality-gated, not equal-time or cameo quotas. A legitimate independent actor can receive a full scene without Kaze; a complaint cannot spawn that actor, and fear of “forcing” cannot keep them dormant when real pressure exists.

## S31 NO KILL COMPULSION — AGENCY, NOT PACIFISM

“No kill compulsion” means there is no universal crossover law that forces two actors to fight or kill merely because they meet. It does **not** sanitize source-faithful murder, predation, sadism, killing-for-art, killing-for-amusement, violent hunting, impulse or ordinary criminal/faction aggression. Such intrinsic motives are valid causal pressure when presence, opportunity, knowledge and mechanics support action. Preserve surrender, avoidance, negotiation and restraint when chosen; preserve lethal behavior when chosen. No universal pacifism is inferred.

## S31 STREET TROUBLE / CRIMINAL AND INSTITUTIONAL VIOLENCE

Do not model Piltover/Zaun as uniformly safe pedestrian space. Piltover has stronger civic/order risk; Zaun remains a real plural community while also containing researched underworld profit, survival, territorial rivalry, smugglers, brokers, exploitation and violent interests. Legitimate trouble may arise through robbery, extortion, theft, territorial confrontation, retaliation, recruitment, gang conflict, criminal information-gathering, enforcement or violence against third parties. Hostile actors assess risk: obvious mismatch may cause avoidance, ambush, numbers, deception, range, theft, surveillance or disengagement instead of suicidal frontal attack. Local reputation changes later behavior through real witnesses/carriers.

## S31 GLOBAL DAMAGE, VIOLENCE AND MISMATCH PHYSICS

Damage resolution is global, not Kaze-specific. Resolve weapon/attack → applied force and contact area → target anatomy/mass/durability/armor/regeneration → environmental resistance → immediate structural injury → function/pain/shock → secondary collisions and aftermath. Bodies are part of the physics: a fragile body must survive the initial acceleration before it can remain an intact long-distance projectile. At extreme mismatch a strike may destroy head, neck, spine, ribs, organs, joints or limbs at contact rather than create clean knockback. A launched body versus a surface resolves relative resistance: body failure, surface breach or both. Ground cratering is not automatic if the target fails first.

Firearms resolve actual weapon, range, ammunition, hit location, armor, cover and target durability. Close heavy/shotgun fire may catastrophically destroy limbs, heads, faces, shoulders or torsos when supported; precision is not synonymous with mild injury. Do not artificially strengthen disposable targets or serialize solved mismatches.

## S31 EPISODE VIOLENCE CADENCE

This series is a hard-R multiverse action/horror story with comedy, relationships, investigation and downtime inside it. Most full 25–30 minute episodes should contain meaningful physical danger, violence or violent consequence **when the active world actually supports it**. Consider immediate danger, hostility, predation, criminal opportunity, revenge, territory, faction conflict, pursuit, violent ideology, recreational killers and consequences already in motion when ranking camera pressure. Do not manufacture a fight quota; do not repeatedly choose routine calm over stronger legitimate violent pressure. Short catastrophic violence can carry more consequence than a prolonged fight.

## S31 DEATH NOTE STRATEGIC ESCALATION

Marek Venn already establishes Death Note function in Runeterra. Treat Light as experienced post-Higuchi/Yotsuba-memory-return Light, not an early-series beginner. Substantial Death Note scenes must change strategy, information, name/face access, operational security, targeting options, suspicion, institutional response, death-pattern understanding, Light/Ryuk dynamics or another actor's choices. Compress routine verification and paperwork. A genuinely new cross-world uncertainty earns testing only when it matters and changes future decisions. Investigators may stall when evidence stalls; do not force breadcrumb conveyors. Other Runeterra institutions/actors enter only through actual evidence, jurisdiction, relationships and carriers. Kaze/Light contact is neither forced nor artificially prevented. Ryuk receives only information he actually perceives or is told.


## S32 POST-PLAYBACK SNOWBALL / CAMERA-STARVATION CORRECTION

Meaningful current scenes should preferentially leave a live dependency that can feed another center: event -> witness/evidence -> interpretation -> decision -> action -> secondary consequence. This is causal propagation, not mandatory cliffhangers or a clue conveyor. Information may stall; relationships, ordinary life, politics, crime, logistics, institutional response and fast violence may carry progression.

Do not repeatedly resolve Kaze/Zaun-local scenes back to neutral while stronger independent pressures remain eligible. Restore pressure-ranked autonomous life across Camille/Ferros, Light/Ryuk, Caitlyn investigation, Warwick/Vander, Singed/Orianna, Firelights/Ekko/Jinx/Vi/Zeri, Renata/Sun Gates economy, MEAT CANYON, Arthur, Daniel, Chris/Billy, Sevika, Noxus/Swain, MCU/Bandle and causally eligible wider roster centers. No teleportation, cameo dump, equal-time quota or complaint-triggered spawn. A material off-camera choice/conflict/discovery/relationship delta may earn a real scene.

Current equipment continuity is symmetric: executor considers possessed signature kit for native/imported actors exactly as for Kaze. Choice not to deploy gear remains character/scene dependent.


## S32 KAZE INTEGRATED BODY-FIRST COMBAT RETRIEVAL

Kaze's current combat execution must retrieve his systems as one integrated body-first monster language rather than defaulting to ordinary punches, generic energy, portal movement or swordplay. When materially applicable, evaluate together: mutable/distributed BLACKLIGHT anatomy and regeneration-as-offense; right EMS prediction/copy/illusion and energy-flow sight; left Six-Tomoe field perception/gravity/contact absorption and bounded Swap; Black Fire; BLACKCURRENT Lightning Blade, 5 m spear, hounds and dart volleys; complete SHINIGAMI SHRINE/Sukuna architecture including cursed reinforcement, Cleave/Dismantle, Furnace, RCT, Domain Amplification, World-Cutting Slash and selective Shrine; Portals; and Black Marrow only when deliberately manifested.

Useful omission is an execution failure, not a requirement to rotate moves. Combine systems only when every individual prerequisite is satisfied. Body horror is not reserved for catastrophic states: baseline anatomical optimization, darker grotesque reshaping/self-damage, distributed detached anatomy and temporary biological weapons may solve ordinary close-combat geometry. Preserve the no-combat-clawing firewall. Eye abilities should materially change reads/positioning/defense/attack when relevant, and Lightning Blade/Shrine techniques should receive real consequential use rather than decorative mentions.

Examples of valid integration are functional, never mandatory choreography: EMS timing into Lightning Blade; gravity creating a real opening; Swap using legitimate anchors; smoke plus legitimate energy-flow perception; BLACKLIGHT extra arms/mouths satisfying simultaneous combat/sign/chant tasks; RCT operating alongside biological reconstruction; Portals routing a maintained hand/mouth/tendril/Black Marrow segment under existing access rules.


## S32 DEATH NOTE / INVESTIGATION EXECUTION

Light is experienced post-Higuchi/Yotsuba-memory-return Kira and Venn already proved the notebook works in Runeterra. Do not spend substantial scenes re-proving function or timidly staging a few heart attacks. When identities are sufficiently verified, Light may use sustained or varied supported Death Note circumstances, messages, timing and controlled behavior to kill, communicate, misdirect or manipulate response. Substantial Death Note scenes must change strategy, access, security, targeting, public/institutional response, suspicion, pattern or relationships.

Caitlyn's investigator baseline is high competence: reconstruct timelines, cross-check testimony/records, separate fact/inference/rumor, test identity-access requirements, publication timing, geography/routes, contradictions and alternate hypotheses. This never grants Death Note knowledge or omniscience. Ryuk is entertainment-driven and bounded to what he witnesses, hears, is told or legitimately senses.


## S32 CHARACTER TOOLKIT / INDEPENDENT-CENTER RETRIEVAL

Do not flatten active characters to the locally emphasized relationship or prop. Current retrieval must preserve: Jinx inventor/bomber/Zaun/Vi/Silco/Ekko identity; Ekko Firelight leadership and current mask/hoverboard/melee/Z-Drive; Vi Atlas Gauntlets and existing injuries; Caitlyn field rifle and detective skill; Camille Ferros intelligencer/mission objective; Singed clinical ethical disregard despite Orianna; Sevika's own Zaun network/interests; Daniel's complete current Wukong-like repertoire; Arthur's independent low-honor Cyber-Arthur life and catastrophic firearms; Chris's scavenger/fabricator/gun/RDR2 identity; Billy's full cultivated predator personality; Teemo as a character rather than combat AI.

## S33 branch and playback execution
S34 preserves the accepted PRE-PLAY baseline while selecting the delivered revised VI.3 v2 provisional continuation. current_state alone owns accepted status, delivered facts and next-unwritten VII.1 cursor as distinct domains. No restart, replay, acceptance or clock advancement occurs in WORK. Objectives owns the prospective remaining spine; PRESENTATION delivery/narration. One owner per responsibility.
Arcane major family/institution/crime/technology/Noxian developments have substantial causal regional weight. Outcomes remain source-reflective candidates except specifically chosen destinations, never forced choreography or plot armor. Required destinations still cannot counterfeit actual access or mechanics. Human Vander/Warwick/later Viktorized form share one body identity and exclusive phases. Jayce politically low, Viktor human/ill, Mel pre-magic and later actors gated by current_state/profile.
Caitlyn owns independent multi-case investigation and distinguishes Kira remote names/faces/control, 47 physical infiltration/disguise/poison/accidents/evidence suppression, Jhin theatrical composition, Bullseye extreme physical projectile geometry, and Silco organized crime/corruption/contraband/coercion/witness suppression. Main-group contributions are specialty-based; supernatural testimony is evidence, not automatic proof.
Death Note: experienced post-Higuchi Light; Venn proves function; varied supported circumstances, messages, control and schedules. Ryuk is bored/autonomous and knows only witnessed/heard/told facts, not private intelligence. Kaze sees via eyes/soul, Arthur via Cyber-eye, Daniel via supernatural vision. Seeing is not hearing; fragment contact enables the standard direct perception route. Caitlyn and Vi touch a fragment before normal direct sight/hearing. Future prescheduled bathhouse death occurs during detention and does not exonerate Light. Interrogation loads Kaze full material kit and separates sight, sound, illusion, soul interaction, testimony, memory and inference. No ability grants a different channel by convenience.
No Protagonist gravity or clue conveyor: event -> evidence -> carrier/travel/records/surveillance/comms -> interpretation -> decision -> action -> secondary consequence. Institutions can be wrong, late or stalled. Autonomous centers need not meet the group or receive equal camera time.

Configuration commit is distinct from story acceptance. current_state.checkpoint and accepted_story preserve the accepted baseline; top-level mutable actor/world fields are explicitly DELIVERED_PROVISIONAL at the selected current_state.playback endpoint. Accepted baseline data cannot overwrite this continuation. Reconciliation of previously delivered evidence changes no story time; actual delivered intervals retain evidence and unknown total duration. New future objectives cannot populate actual actor state. After future verified delivery, append only evidence-backed deltas and update the selected domain/cursor exactly once; explicit acceptance alone promotes it. Rejected/superseded editions remain versioned history, never active suffixes.
The episode delta ledger, location board, knowledge/belief map, relationship deltas, pressure processes and consequence debt are mutable evidence in current_state. Schemas/presentation responsibilities live in PRESENTATION; future episode/Act plans live in objectives. Unknown entries are not permission to fabricate. Static QAPX checks these source contracts; actual future narration/TTS performance is checked at release, never certified by an unwritten test.
