# DANIEL — CHARACTER / COMBAT / PROGRESSION OWNER

Source family: SRC-01. Authorized scoped rework: GEN-II s11, 2026-09-23. Availability and accepted occurrences come from `state/current_state.yaml`; the repertoire is `canon/characters/daniel_repertoire.yaml`, and individual joke delivery is `canon/characters/daniel_humor.md`. These storage modules use existing CRE-00 through CRE-14, not a new engine.

## Identity and supersession

Daniel is the same original character, now a **Saiyan + mythic Wukong-like simian Cryomancer with permanent Byakugan**. This is project-owned fictional hybrid design, not a claim about canonical Saiyan or mythological monkey biology. He is no longer Shimon Vastaya. The former thief/chaos-agent, hit-and-run scavenger, compulsive petty acquisition, shameless-bullshitter identity, unstable possession tracking, selfish-calculator framing and opportunism-to-Seven-investment arc are removed. Mischief does not restore them. Ghost/revenant/undead nature and dark-magic resurrection are rejected. Do not restore ghost powers through old brainstorming names.

Daniel is mythological **Sun Wukong's uncle**, not the League champion's uncle. The family relationship, Wukong's reluctance to advertise him, and Daniel's genuine capability to defeat Wukong are approved. Defeat is not necessarily permanent death and does not make every exchange a guaranteed win. Exact biological/social genealogy, specific prior family incidents and unprovided shared history remain protected; the suggested sworn-uncle/Chapter-7 configuration was not accepted. No parents, historical cookouts, prior sparring victories or teacher biographies are invented to explain the relationship. Sun Wukong's own abilities remain source-owned.

## Season Two entrance / current-state boundary

Newest state owns presence and availability: Daniel is already a returning main traveler in the Second Temporal Relaunch and is in the lower-Zaun working group. The older deep-sleep rediscovery entrance and Daniel/Zion mandatory-death destination are superseded by s19/s24. Neither is a current obligation, past death or resurrection premise. No duplicate Daniel is instantiated.

The approved non-form-specific character/repertoire remains available under its exact mechanics. Exact starting transformation access and transient condition remain controlled by current_state; the art strip does not unlock forms. Current insertion intoxication and current form remain UNKNOWN where not established. The sustained drunken combat design below cannot manufacture a current intoxication measurement, awake action or recovered blackout event. bottle_upgrade_completed remains false. No missing owner detail supplies a new event or progression.

## Personality / social behavior

Daniel is friendly, easily sidetracked, quick-witted, absurdly funny and heavily dad-joke prone. His verbal thinking is sharp: he follows a conversation and remembers his sentences. Apparent losing-the-thread or forgetting is deliberate deception when he chooses it, not a default slow-minded gag. He can laugh at his own line or deliver a terrible pun seriously. Actual unconsciousness/blackout keeps its separately established limits.

His Wukong-like mischief is biological, behavioral and martial: hanging upside down while talking, climbing inconvenient structures, appearing at an unexpected angle, playful baiting, physical competitions and reciprocal one-upmanship. Friends can genuinely out-joke, outperform and embarrass him; he can enjoy it and try again. Affectionate competition is not universal hostility or an obligation to win. Relationships, loyalty thresholds, fears and moral decisions not fixed here remain grounded in actual history, current motives and later accepted choices—not imported from the discarded thief personality.

Against opponents he chooses to harm, the same mischief becomes lethally weaponized: false falls, wrong-clone bait, misleading weapon range, unexpected foot grips, body-orbit reversals, freeze traps and humiliating setups. He may construct a real tactical trick partly because making a joke physically literal amuses him. Humor does not soften his force or compel him to prolong a solved fight. His opponent may notice, resist, ignore, counter or exploit a trick; neither a joke nor a label supplies success.

## Alcohol: all combat is actually drunk

**Daniel is drunk twenty-four seven because he constantly drinks hard liquor.** No sober combat mode; he is not merely imitating intoxication. His mastered disciplines, perception, Cryomancy, monkey mobility and every transformation operate around his actual drunk baseline. Serious focus means focused drunk Daniel, not sudden sobriety. God, Blue, Beast and Absolute Beast never cleanse intoxication or replace his personality.

Distinguish: ordinary intoxicated Daniel; greater intoxication and poorer judgment/coordination where present; alcohol blackout (active but not forming retrievable episodic memories); deep drunken sleep/passing out (not active fighting). These are not a mandatory linear sequence, numerical BAC ladder or guaranteed escalating power states. His fictional competence is supported by his approved body/training/powers, not a general claim that alcohol improves real martial performance. Intoxication does not create unknown techniques or another evil personality.

It is not uncommon for Daniel to regain awareness to brutal aftermath he caused—dead opponents, blood, damaged terrain—and respond **“damn.. again tho?”** No convenient recovery flashbacks. He learns from actual friends, witnesses, survivors, recordings or evidence; their reports may be limited or mistaken. He can remember being told without remembering the original episode. Missing-time portions without evidence stay unknown. The recurring premise does not demand a massacre after every drink or create prior victims during source installation.

Previously mastered moves and associated jokes can execute in a blackout; afterward he does not remember them. A novel improvised combination observed by a witness is not automatically a consciously integrated permanent lesson. He must later reproduce/understand it, or other actual evidence must establish the learning. Neither Byakugan nor a clone is a hidden event recorder.

## Unified combat architecture

**External movement:** Drunken Master + breakdance + lucha-libre rotations.

**Technical foundation:** Drunken Wing Chun, Hung Ga (Tiger/Crane), Praying Mantis, Bruce-Lee/Jeet-Kune-Do-inspired interception, economical direct attacks and explosive short power.

**Weapon extension:** Wukong-like polearm athleticism expressed through a **spear**, Chinese spear principles, Ninja-Assassin-style blade-chain movement, the retained flexible-weapon skills expressed through his one chain blade.

**Integrated capability:** Saiyan physical output, Byakugan targeting, Cryomancy, ice constructions and simian hand/foot manipulation. These are one adaptable fighting language, not a required rotation through styles. Individual moves and aliases are in the repertoire registry; no move-announcer default except Daniel's explicitly mandatory joke-special rule.

**Functional capability routing:** for consequential Daniel action use **problem -> HAND-TO-HAND / WEAPONS / CRYOMANCY / MOVEMENT-MISCHIEF / ADAPTATION -> currently available mechanics -> valid combination -> resistance -> drunken Daniel's actual choice -> consequence**. This does not sober him, create a move quota or erase his mandatory joke-special callout exceptions.

- **HAND-TO-HAND** retrieves his drunken Wing Chun/Hung Ga/Praying Mantis/JKD-inspired striking, lucha/breakdance transitions, throws and brutal body mechanics.
- **WEAPONS** retrieves spear, flexible-weapon disciplines, foot manipulation, ice-made weapons and legitimate hand/foot transfers.
- **CRYOMANCY** retrieves cold, ice anatomy, weapons, clones, terrain, snow/weather pressure and form-specific ice where currently earned.
- **MOVEMENT / MISCHIEF** retrieves simian parkour, gripping feet, false falls, drunken-breakdance-lucha movement, bait, humiliating setups and joke-literalization when actually useful.
- **ADAPTATION** retrieves MONKEY SEE, MONKEY DO -> DRUNKEN SYNTHESIS -> PROOF through real observation/practice and compatibility; it never steals an absent power source by watching.

His fighting is **brutal and ridiculously hard-hitting**: compact palms/punches, severe body shots, side kicks, elbows, knees, shoulders, throws, face-first slams, weapon impacts and cold-assisted follow-ups. Loose appearance conceals enormous force and placement. He can abruptly root for a heavy Hung Ga strike then flow back to a collapse or spin. Terrain, guards, anatomy, durability, distance, footing and resistance actually govern damage. No safety-bump wrestling or guaranteed bone-breaking by move name.

Continuous movement may follow **flip → contact → rotate → redirect → fall → roll → rebound → trap → strike → launch**, without an artificial neutral-stance reset. A miss or enemy catch can become a new pivot if physical control permits. Not every mistake is a secret feint. A solved mismatch can end in a short attack rather than a mandatory spectacular aerial combination.

### Simian biology / Raiden-style foot-weapon lane

Daniel has real gripping anatomy and dexterity in his feet, not ordinary human feet functioning impossibly. Feet are **full combat manipulators**, not backup hands. He can climb, hang, swing, scramble, vault, traverse beams/branches/ledges, fight inverted and use large opponents as moving terrain when contact and leverage permit. No imaginary foothold, adhesion field or unlimited flight is supplied by parkour.

He can hold and manipulate his spear, a blade/chain handle or a generated ice weapon with a foot; transfer hand → foot → opposite foot → hand; control chain tension; retrieve a dropped item; hang by his hands while attacking with a foot; or plant both hands and weaponize windmills/flares/airflares with a foot-held weapon. One free limb may retain the bottle. MGS4 Raiden is the visual/choreographic influence; Daniel uses simian anatomy, not imported cybernetic heel clamps or high-frequency weapon physics.

Daniel wears **no footwear** in any form; his gripping feet remain exposed and usable. Byakugan aids orientation but is not unlimited attention, automatic reaction or guaranteed safe landing.

## Byakugan and approved precision arts

Both eyes are **permanently Byakugan**: pale white/lavender-white irises, recognizable iris structure, and Daniel's own facial proportions. No brown-eyed Base or off-state normal-eye panel. Deliberate intensive use can increase temple veins, focus and strain; permanence does not require every kind of vision at maximum strength at every moment.

Approved capabilities include near-all-around vision with the retained small blind spot; telescopic/penetrative sight at supported conditions; motion tracking; visible chakra pathways/tenketsu where those systems actually exist. Range, simultaneous attention and foreign concealment interactions are not limitless. Neither vision nor a visible muscle contraction is infallible prediction.

Daniel's approved learned/adapted package includes Gentle Fist, 32/64/128 Palms, Palms Revolving Heaven/Rotation, Air/Vacuum/Twin Palm variants, directional internal-flow intervention, cryo variants, weapon-assisted targeting and form-specific combinations. These are expressly selected Daniel adaptations, not proof every named technique exists in every Naruto continuity or an automatic download supplied by the eye. Native acquisition/provenance, detailed energy compatibility and unestablished conduction still route to protected unknowns.

Foreign bodies do not automatically contain Naruto's 361 nodes. When he can actually perceive a targetable system, he can investigate and test it; identification is not complete knowledge. A failed chakra shutdown does not erase legitimate external force or cold damage. Conversely, enormous Saiyan force does not make every internal technique ignore armor, contact, anatomy or barriers. Tenketsu spear/chain techniques require a valid physical and energy-delivery interface, not just accurate aim. Byakugan is not arbitrary remote organ freezing.

## Cryomancy / literal ice anatomy

Cold generation/control, frozen terrain, localized snow, vapor, breath effects, ice weapons, ice clones and body-transfer are approved. Daniel's arrival can be sensed through temperature drop and falling snow before he is visible. Actual range, control and stronger weather pressure follow his available state; no instant global weather rewrite.

In active combat his forearms from approximately the elbows down can become **literal cryomantic ice anatomy**, with articulated hands/fingers, dense translucent blue-white structure, deeper-blue internal grain/fractures and reinforced striking surfaces. This is not merely frosted gloves. Reversible visual conversion is allowed. Exact damage, regrowth, sensation and energy-conduction consequences outside established function remain protected; no automatic whole-body regeneration, limb duplication or free healing inferred.

His weapon set is reduced to **spear, Ninja-Assassin-style chain blade and shurikens**, including compatible ice-made versions. The old standalone swords/daggers/axes/claws/hooks and extra segmented weapons are retired from his weapon menu. Terrain spikes remain terrain shaping, not an extra carried arsenal. An emergency ice pole is not a replacement for his signature spear. Articulated/flexible weapon functionality requires a supporting construction; ice hardness alone does not make a rigid object flex like chain. Mass, strength, attention, energy and simultaneous constructs remain physical/owned constraints without invented numerical caps.

Freezing selected segmented-weapon joints can temporarily stiffen their geometry; releasing the ice restores flexible behavior. Cryo footing, rails, walls, anchors and clone supports enable real pivots/rebounds when they can sustain the load. Cryomancy does not supply infinite kinetic energy, guaranteed two-times speed, an impenetrable spinning disc or automatically locked enemies. The earlier rough-draft hyperbole about those outcomes is not an extra mechanic.

Cold is not universal soul/time/concept freezing. Unknown compatibility is indeterminate, not automatic success or immunity. Black-Ice Beast's dark dense ice is an approved material manifestation, not inherently indestructible.

### Ice Clones / transfer

Daniel can create frozen Daniel-shaped decoys/obstacles/contact traps and establish another clone as an exit. **Daniel's current position crystallizes into an ice shell; he transfers and physically breaks out of the other already-established clone**, scattering shards/frost/vapor and continuing a movement or attack. A visually frozen/trapped/dead source shell can deceive an observer; no guarantee the observer is fooled.

Cold Snap Clone, Ice Coffin Fake-Out, Shatter Step and Clone Reversal are accepted applications. Clone Reversal at contact still resolves against the attack's actual timing. No preemptive successful escape is assumed merely because it would be stylish. Whiteout and drunken poses strengthen misdirection only against actual perception.

A clone is a construct, not a new Daniel identity/soul, independent full-power character or infinite clone army. Bottle/weapon shapes on a decoy are ice representations, not duplicated real inventory. Transfer does not automatically heal injury, sober him, restore memory, refresh resources or escape Billy's containment. Max count/range, time/cost, realm/barrier access, maintenance, interruption/exit destruction and cargo/passenger rules remain protected where not already defined. Block the dependent unknown transition, not the existence of the approved local technique.

## Liquor bottle — current vessel / retired upgrade

Daniel carries a substantial **large-ish clear glass bottle of hard liquor**, without VODKA text or branding. **Wukong-like magic replenishes the liquid; Cryomancy controls temperature.** These are separate from container strength. Ongoing replenishment supports his perpetual drinking; pouring/spitting for approved combat remains physical. No unlimited instantaneous flood rate, hydraulic weapon or mass-production output is inferred from a personal refill trick.

The initial vessel is **breakable**. If broken/lost, any replacement/enchantment requires actual acquisition/access rather than a bottle silently respawning. Refill does not duplicate a stolen bottle, guarantee return, grant invulnerability, or sober Daniel.

The previously planned Chris-made indestructible-bottle upgrade is retired under Chris's later two-project-only priority correction. The current bottle keeps its established refill/chill properties and remains physically breakable. No completed upgrade or universal fabrication power is supplied.

Alcohol flame breath uses the approved fictional supernatural ignition/projection; it is not a real fire-breathing instruction. Flame, cold, ice, vomit and physical follow-ups can combine through their actual routes. Vomit is not automatically acid/poison/infinite mass. Frozen-puke family and all exact joke constraints are in `daniel_humor.md`.

## MONKEY SEE, MONKEY DO / DRUNKEN SYNTHESIS / PROOF

Daniel progresses by **observation → attempted imitation → adaptation → practice → permanent integration of compatible principles**. Byakugan supplies information; mythic simian imitation/improvisation supplies an aptitude; Saiyan training supplies real physical development; none is an arbitrary stolen power source.

First imitation can be fast yet incomplete, mistimed, overpowered, inefficient or unsuccessful. No compulsory mistake quota; a compatible simple principle may click promptly. Actual repeated use or meaningful application establishes mastery. **DRUNKEN SYNTHESIS** is the process of making a lesson work with Daniel's own drunken movement, limbs, weapons, energy and Cryomancy rather than cosmetically copying another fighter. **PROOF** denotes a genuine integrated mastery/breakthrough, not alcohol quantity, XP or a count of acquired moves.

He learns from opponents, friends, mentors or legitimate observations. He cannot copy a soul, species, memories, artifact, divine office or absent energy source by watching. Knowledge can outpace the body's execution; a previously understood lesson can become usable after later genuine physical/control progression. Neither unseen scenes nor an alcohol blackout automatically banks new mastered skills. His friendly competitions provide opportunities, not scheduled mentors or automatic success.

It does not delete genuine biological growth or grant a new transformation after an arbitrary number of lessons.

The unselected 36-point recommendation did not settle them.

His existing skills, permanent eyes, simian features and **actual intoxication** survive every form. Approved visual/behavioral direction: God uses quieter controlled cold; Blue emphasizes cryo precision; Beast increases snow/temperature pressure; Cryo Beast creates a blizzard mantle; Black-Ice Beast adds transient dense ice reinforcement rather than permanent bulky armor; Absolute Beast favors controlled stillness and compact, devastating impact over merely the largest aura. Delayed visual registration of an impact is not invented time-delayed causality. No form forces him into a generic sober energy-brawler personality.

## Visual lock / evidence routing

The approved `13_DANIEL_OFFICIAL_REFERENCE.jpeg` is included; older photos/concepts are historical evidence, not additional upload dependencies. Use the preserved textual appearance locks here; historical form panels never grant availability or mechanics. Unavailable original visual details stay unknown. ## S29 MYTHIC INSIGHT / MONKEY ANATOMY / COMBAT USE
Daniel looks more visibly Wukong-like while remaining Daniel: expressive simian brow/ears/cheek framing, stronger monkey anatomy, gripping bare feet and an active prehensile tail. Keep recognizable facial identity and permanent Byakugan. Daniel is an exceptional pickpocket/lockpicker, and willingly tricks, swindles, finesses or dupes people outside the group, its associates and his personal interests. He is the group's best reader of manipulation and uses that skill to protect them. He can play stupid and deliberately ride a con until he reverses it. “The last being you'd want to play chess with” establishes strategic menace; a separate literal chess rating or biography is not invented.

Daniel's current breakable clear bottle continues to replenish through Wukong-like magic, but the replenished liquid is specifically **Daniel's own unique magical alcohol**. ## S36 MORAL DECISION PROFILE

Qualitative writing profile informed by Schwartz value priorities and Moral Foundations concerns; not test scores, scientific diagnosis, exhaustive ranking or nine-alignment assignment. Explicit canon and user choices govern; unknowns stay unknown.

Daniel priorities: play, stimulation, ingenuity, friendly competition and chosen attachment. He helps innocent strangers selectively: connection/liking, irritation or offense at the attacker, excitement/worthwhile challenge, or the wishes of someone he cares about can motivate intervention. Once an opponent is helpless he generally finishes or moves on, rather than lingering to enjoy suffering; this supplies no automatic execution or mercy rule. If he knowingly harms an innocent person to obtain something he wants, his usual response is regret while considering it worth doing, then moving on without trying to repair the harm. This explicit default supersedes the earlier staged “depends” answer. Do not restore the removed selfish-calculator/thief personality or presume a broad fairness principle. Exact deeper value hierarchy and particular exceptions remain unknown; no compulsory alignment label.

# KAZE VS. MULTIVERSE — MODULAR CHARACTER CANON

> Current logical owner; availability comes from `state/current_state.yaml`. Provenance does not override live canon.


### CHRIS — NO KI / NO MAGIC

Chris has no Ki, Ki control, Ki sensing, Ki blasts, magic aptitude, spellcasting, or magic utility. Any older Chris Ki/magic split is void.

### BELLY OF THE BILLY — EARNED KNOCKTURNAL EVOLUTION

Billy's evolved stomach-space is officially **BELLY OF THE BILLY**.

**Accepted trigger/current state:** Hulk/Banner's Infinity-Stone Nano-Gauntlet Snap in the first Temporal Relaunch evolved Billy's existing stomach-space into BELLY OF THE BILLY. The Second Temporal Relaunch carries that earned evolution back to the pilot opening, so BELLY OF THE BILLY is already current before the repeated restored-timeline Snap. Repeating the trigger does not create BELLY OF THE BILLY², duplicate zones or unrelated new mechanics.

It is an earned zoned pocket-space evolved from the stomach lounge. The controlling section names/functions are:
- **THE FLESHLIGHT** — Chris/eligible BELLY OF THE BILLY occupants' one-way exterior observation function using Billy's hat front aperture as a GoPro-style viewpoint; it is not a separate exterior hole or matter-transfer interface;
- **MEAT CANYON** — living-prisoner containment;
- **SHIT I NEED** — useful salvage/object storage;
- **BOYS CLUB** — trusted-person access to the actual living space; this is a meaningful trust threshold, not generic intake/prison/salvage/quarantine;
- **DONT NEED BUT MIGHT CHANGE** — acid/trash/disposal and last-chance salvage;
- **DANGEROUS?** — quarantine for unknown technology, unstable machinery, explosives, radiation, biological hazards, cursed/strange objects and similar uncertain material;
- **BIG NIGGA SHIT** — oversized/unsorted intake such as Transformers, vehicles, huge machinery, building sections, terrain and similar large material;
- **CLEAR MEAT** — transparent living biological barriers/walls/dividers/gates/corridors/isolation structures. It is flesh, not literal glass.

Existing non-conflicting specialized areas may persist, but exact total dimensions and internal geometry remain protected unless separately established. Successful swallowing does **not** automatically send a person/object to acid. **Billy consciously chooses the immediate BELLY OF THE BILLY destination of swallowed material, subject to the occupied-large-object separation rule below.** Chris may request a destination; Billy retains agency and may agree, disagree, troll, or reroute for safety. - **MEME MECHANICS** — Billy's established absurd biological/event logic may simply work where its owner says it works. Do not over-engineer the joke merely to make it look realistic.

Billy's meme-level existence may support absurd swallowing scale/speed, BELLY OF THE BILLY accommodation and movement isolation without an engineering lecture. **Consequences remain GEN-II-real:** prisoners retain agency, unknown technology remains unknown, salvage can be damaged, dangerous objects stay dangerous, acid takes time according to material, engineering still needs understanding, and Chris/Billy can disagree.

**Chris routing:**
- **GUNFIGHTING** — current completed Arthur mentorship, current Dead Eye, current two-revolver system, with VIOLET ASCENDANCY benefits still unearned, and current THE CRITIC where its actual ammunition/support allows;
- **FABRICATION** — tools, measurement, repair, prototyping, current THE CRITIC maintenance/reconfiguration, and later engineering only through legitimate knowledge/materials;

VIOLET ASCENDANCY and its body/eye/invisibility/elite-cognition benefits are future/unearned and must be developed/administered on screen. ## CHRIS / CATFISH BILLY DEEP-CHARACTER ARCHITECTURE — CONFIRMED
This section is character-simulation architecture, not a list of guaranteed scene beats. It cannot force a joke, separation event, betrayal, meal, transformation, or conflict merely because the architecture can support one.

**Billy master principle — Freedom vs. Attachment:** Billy genuinely wants safe bodily independence while also accumulating relationships, habits, pleasures, history, and attachments that can make freedom increasingly expensive. This is the **Exit Paradox**: success at finding a safe exit can create a harder personal choice rather than retroactively proving he never wanted freedom. Do not predetermine whether he ultimately leaves.

**Weaponized Ridiculousness:** Billy may be strategically misleading, performatively stupid, intuitively clever, or sincerely stupid. Do not reveal every absurd act as hidden genius. His unpredictability partly comes from the fact that ridiculous behavior can be authentic rather than camouflage.

**Comedy as threat camouflage:** serious intent does not automatically remove Billy's humor. A joke can coexist with active predation or tactical thought. Do not make humor proof that he is unserious, and do not make every joke secretly tactical.

**Audience complicity:** Billy's fourth-wall awareness may let him treat the audience as an asymmetrical witness to things he does not tell Chris. This does not grant source-document access, future-script knowledge, or facts outside the existing fourth-wall firewall.

**Billy appetite ecology:** appetite may influence attention, memory, travel priorities, diplomacy, curiosity, grudges, bargaining, mythology, and combat choices when the circumstances genuinely make food salient. Food does not automatically outrank danger or mission stakes. Billy may remember people partly through what they fed him, judge unfamiliar cultures through food, interrupt for food when he sincerely believes there is time, or knowingly eat obvious bait. These remain choices, not a supernatural appetite compulsion.

**Gastronomic threat assessment / stomach diplomacy:** Billy can retain food-related information with absurd specificity while forgetting information that interested him less. Meals can become relationship history. Enemies, strangers, and allies may react to his appetite according to their own values rather than joining the joke automatically.

**Subjective taste reviews:** Billy may describe the taste of victims, creatures, objects, armor, terrain, or other bizarre material he eats. His tasting language may be grotesque, metaphorical, nonsensical, or oddly specific. It is subjective sensory commentary, not automatic chemical analysis, memory access, soul reading, power identification, or forensic truth.

**Bottomless-belly mythology:** witnessed eating behavior may mutate into rumor far beyond the objective event. Billy may encourage an exaggerated legend because he finds it funny. Rumor never upgrades his actual stomach mechanics.

**Chris master principle — Competence as Psychological Territory:** Chris often turns chaos into something he can frame, understand, negotiate with, criticize, joke about, or perform competence around. Establishing the frame can help him become genuinely useful, but confidence never proves complete knowledge.

**Frame Control / Competence Theater:** Chris may define an interaction as a kitchen problem, social bit, technical problem, negotiation, argument, or game-like pattern because a usable frame gives him cognitive footing. Sometimes the frame is useful; sometimes he overcommits to it or reality simply does not cooperate.

**Belief Wound:** Chris's belief that Billy would not truly leave him is psychologically distinct from whether Billy seeks safe independence. If future accepted evidence ever disproves Chris's belief, the wound may involve love, judgment, loyalty, pride, and the fact that Chris defended an incorrect model. The event and exact reaction remain future causality, not a guaranteed betrayal scene.

**Passenger Who Can Still Matter:** while the interior is active (including Chris exterior), Chris lacks external motor authority but retains consciousness, observation, memory, speech through the banjo, judgment, persuasion, and other already-established information/social agency. Chris can be correct while unable to execute; Billy can be wrong while physically sovereign. This is not telepathy or shared consciousness.

**Fourth-wall student distinction:** Chris learned audience awareness from Billy but does not inherit Billy's personality, history, dimensional travel, private knowledge, or intuitive relationship to the phenomenon. Chris may reason about the fourth wall differently from Billy while remaining bounded by the same information firewall.

**RDR2 emotional investment / interpretive contamination:** Chris is genuinely emotionally invested in Red Dead Redemption 2's characters, plot, betrayals, deaths, relationships, failures, and repeated playthroughs. He can launch into badly timed sincere rants or tangents about Arthur, Dutch, Micah, Hosea, John, Sadie, the gang, plans, betrayal, or other remembered material. Knowing a scene's outcome does not cancel his emotional reaction on replay.

RDR2 is part of Chris's associative vocabulary, not a prophecy engine. He may use game logic or story parallels as hypotheses, emotional shorthand, or jokes. Those analogies can be useful, irrelevant, or wrong. Cross-universe listeners who lack the reference may misunderstand his comments, and repeated misunderstandings may mutate into folklore without making RDR2 history real in that world.

**Two-Person One-Body Problem:** when Billy is active, one external acting body contains two distinct conscious perspectives with different motives, knowledge, stakes, and autonomy interests. Billy owns motor control; Chris retains bounded informational/social agency. GEN-II must not collapse them into one decision-maker. The recurring autonomy question is who has the right to act when bodily control, survival, responsibility, and consequences are distributed between different people.

## CHRIS — CATFISH’S MEOW / FABRICATION / POSSESSIONS

**CATFISH’S MEOW** is Chris's salvage/repurposing framework, not a power or automatic upgrade engine. The preferred cycle is: Billy swallows → Chris appraises → keep / collect / strip / build / repair / repurpose → Billy digests unwanted leftovers. Outside Billy, Chris may inspect and salvage legitimately accessible material through the same ordinary requirements. The framework does not depend on earning BELLY OF THE BILLY; its persistent BELLY OF THE BILLY workshop/home infrastructure does.

Acquisition and use require legitimate acquisition, physical access, tools, time, sufficient task-specific understanding, compatible materials and actual circumstances. Objects, machinery, equipment, debris, remains and accessible components are eligible. Possession never grants understanding, activation, copied supernatural powers, command authority, ownership of resisting beings or universal compatibility. Living/sentient arrivals retain agency; stripping them requires legitimate defeat, incapacitation, cooperation, component separation or another actual physical access condition. Swallowing alone supplies none of these outcomes.

Salvage difficulty generally increases from raw materials to conventional mechanisms, advanced functional technology, alien/cross-system technology and ontological/supernatural components. Souls, Sparks, magic, dimensional cores, alien operating systems and supernatural authority are never plug-and-play. Chris can recognize understandable properties—a bearing, plate, motor, spring, cable, optic, bracket, fastener or structural material—without understanding an entire alien system. Unknown compatibility stays unknown.

Every upgrade needs provenance. THE CRITIC may gain stronger materials, optics, recoil control, heat handling, feeding or stabilization only through real acquired properties. No generic damage bonuses. BONER may receive legitimate support modifications without redesigning its owner-protected blade/handle identity.

**Practical improviser:** Chris asks what he can make something do, not only what it was designed to do. Kitchen hardware, vehicle parts, weapons, wiring, plating, broken tools, machinery and compatible salvage may become patched, asymmetric, welded, bolted, strapped, taped, overbuilt or tweaker-rigged devices. Ugly is not incompetent. Adequate knowledge, tools, materials and time can produce sound engineering. A weld can break, bracket twist, wire overheat, mount tear loose, recoil loosen hardware, wrong power source fry a component, vibration defeat a mechanism, wrong material fail or misunderstood interface stop a build. Some builds work once. Failure must follow causes, never a sudden plot demand.

**Obsessive fabrication:** challenge can intensify fixation. Chris may stay on a project for extreme stretches, then emerge exhausted, proud, irritable and sleep-deprived, eager to show it off: “I stayed up three fucken days making this shit. Check it out.” This is a voice lane, not a scheduled event or sleep immunity. Telling him it cannot work may provoke another attempt, not guarantee success.

**Collector / possessive hoarder:** utility, rarity, appearance, personal history, sentiment, absurdity, provenance and perceived future use all affect retention. Objective value does not determine attachment. Touching, moving, damaging, stealing, discarding, consuming, dismantling or repurposing his possessions can irritate or anger him; escalation is contextual, never automatic murder. He may refuse useful dismantling because an object is collectible, producing a real self-imposed resource limitation.

**Functional mess / personal topology:** “Yeah, it looks like a mess, but it’s my mess, so I know where shit is” usually holds. He often remembers the pile, container, object underneath, tool placement, correct nearly identical component or evidence something moved. This is ordinary spatial memory, not tracking magic. He can forget, lose things, misremember or become overloaded. New clutter can be mapped; unannounced relocation corrupts that map. Outsiders cleaning/reorganizing can make retrieval worse. An extremely controlled current work surface and strict chef station discipline can coexist with surrounding chaos.


**Persistent workshop / no flat surface is safe:** BELLY OF THE BILLY's working space functions like a mechanic garage, fabrication shop, junkyard, tweaker bench, hoarder nest and occasional chef station. Ordinary legitimately acquired tools can include torches/welders/soldering gear/heat guns; drills/impact drivers/grinders/rotary tools/saws/files; hammers/pry tools/screwdrivers/pliers/cutters/wire tools; wrenches/ratchets/sockets; vise/clamps; multimeters/calipers/tape; taps/dies/rivets; jacks/pulleys/come-alongs; cords/questionable power strips; batteries/motors/switches/relays/circuit boards; bearings/springs/gears/chains/brackets/fasteners; wire/hoses/tubing; epoxy/sealants/tape; donor machinery, scrap and improvised tools. Their presence still requires legitimate acquisition. Specialized work still needs the required machinery, interfaces, precision, material, expertise, measurement and power.

Every table, counter, bench, shelf, cart, crate lid, cabinet, appliance top and other usable horizontal surface tends to accumulate parts/projects/clutter. Chris may clear one task-sized active patch; clutter returns. A clean counter is unusual unless Chris or somebody else deliberately cleared it. Chef mise-en-place may create one highly controlled island inside the larger mess.

**Project backlog:** the current approved future work consists only of the hidden blade and serum. Existing salvage, parts, tools, repairs and abandoned remnants may exist only when actually established; do not spawn dozens of new named builds or invent a 50-project workshop inventory from an old generic mood description.

Labels are immediate, functional and profane rather than forced-clever UI: **GOOD ONE, DON'T USE, BROKEN BUT NOT BROKEN, NEED THIS, OTHER ONE, THIS ONE FITS, DON'T FUCKEN TOUCH, FIX LATER, GOOD IDEA??, I KNOW WHERE IT IS** are valid examples. Major BELLY OF THE BILLY section names remain the locked names above.

Repair-before-replace is a strong tendency: broken objects become projects, donor parts or backups. Duplicate objects may be the usable one, backup, donor, good one, collectible or experimental version. Working tools are especially protected; misuse, loss or incorrect return can irritate him more than ordinary clutter. Failed/superseded prototypes may remain as donor material, sentimental first versions or records of development: the workshop can show a **prototype cemetery**, not upgrades materializing from nowhere.

Flexible habits include tiny-part vindication, “don’t leave yet, I’m checking shit,” challenge-triggered engineering, showing off inventions, calling dibs, reluctant lending, fast thrift-store-style appraisal and suspicious-object “don’t fuck with this pile” quarantine. These create neither ownership over resisting beings nor scene quotas.

Informal appraisal categories include **KEEP, PARTS, PROJECT, COLLECTIBLE, DIGEST**. They are thought habits, not supernatural UI labels. A spectacular item can be trash to Chris while a tiny bracket matters intensely. After legitimate inspection/stripping, Billy may digest what Chris explicitly relinquishes. Chris need not keep everything. Authorizing digestion and later remembering a wanted component is a legitimate loss; narration cannot restore it for convenience.

When BELLY OF THE BILLY is earned, its home/lounge/workshop/hoarder-museum/pantry can gradually accumulate cookware, knives, spices, preserved food, dry goods, cans, containers, hunting equipment, unusual ingredients, legitimately acquired refrigeration solutions, salvage, tools, collectibles and prototypes. Inventory, condition, clutter and placement persist between scenes. No spontaneous stocked workshop, pantry or refrigeration. Baseline unexplained lounge/RDR2/Pepsi equipment retains its existing specific canon and grants no general fabrication or supply exemption.


## CHRIS — CHEF / FIREARM / RDR2 LANGUAGE

**Competence does not suppress absurdity.** Chris may perform elite future firearms work while ranting about RDR2, using kitchen/review language, arguing with Billy, looting, making a bad joke or otherwise remaining recognizably Chris. THE CRITIC intensifies rather than deletes this character lane; genuine concentration/silence remains available when the shot itself demands it.

Vocabulary remains flexible, not a list of mandatory powers or catchphrases. **MISE EN PLACE** means preparing tools/loadout (“Mise en place, bitch” is available); **FIRE THE TABLE** can initiate fire/combat through its kitchen association; **86’D** means removed/killed. Behind!, Corner! and Hot! can cross into combat callouts. Send it back, undercooked, overdone, plated, raw in the middle, one star, service sucked, atmosphere hostile and full review are organic food/review vocabulary. Firearm competence remains earned; saying a phrase grants none.

RDR2 one-to-three-star animal/pelt language can overlap restaurant/media reviews, target quality and Chris's own execution: one star poor/disappointing; two competent/good but flawed; three/perfect serious/high-quality. These are subjective verdicts, not scanners. Clean-kill philosophy, weapon/angle/shot obsession, ruined-the-pelt complaints, perfect-pelt language, legendary-animal slang, wrong-weapon reassessment and study/track as ordinary observation are valid. Skin, fight and cooking quality may overlap. Arthur's judgment of clean execution can matter emotionally after their relationship is earned. No literal RDR2 hunting rules become physical law, and Dead Eye never obtains evidence it lacks.


**RDR2 remains an active obsession and ordinary speech filter.** Chris naturally uses game language outside direct controller moments when the comparison fits: loot/looting; Honor/negative honor; GREET -> GREET -> ANTAGONIZE; Wanted/lawmen/bounties/witnesses; Dead Eye comparisons after it is actually relevant; satchel/inventory; loot drops; hunting/pelts/carcasses/camp/horse/poker; weapon maintenance; tonics/provisions; Dutch/Micah/Tahiti/Arthur references. Lines in the lane of "red enemy dot," "negative honor as fuck," or "we ain't looted everybody" are available examples, not mandatory catchphrases. Chris remains modern/profane/chef/tweaker/hoarder Chris rather than an Arthur impersonation.

## CHRIS — COMPULSIVE LOOTING

In stomach-space RDR2, Chris habitually loots essentially every accessible body after free-roam encounters, gang fights and missions. Mission NPCs may rush Arthur while Chris keeps checking and becomes irritated. “I’m fucken looting. There might be some good shit here. See? I found 68 cents” captures the tiny-find reinforcement: this is why you check. No exact incident is prewritten.

In crossover reality he similarly wants to inspect accessible bodies, equipment, debris, containers, weapons and machinery after conflict. Urgent danger can override the habit. Looting does not magically reveal hidden objects or confer ownership. Inspection requires actual access and time. The post-fight inspect → loot → appraise → keep/collect/strip/build → digest-leftovers lifecycle routes through CATFISH’S MEOW above.

## CHRIS FOURTH-WALL TRAINING — CURRENT
Chris historically lacked literal fourth-wall awareness; the old "can't even break the first wall" rule describes that earlier stage only. Billy has now taught Chris how to perceive and break the fourth wall. Chris therefore has literal audience awareness in current continuity, while remaining Chris rather than becoming a copy of Billy's personality or knowledge base. The training is not retroactive: Chris does not automatically gain private facts, rejected-playback knowledge, source-document access, or facts Billy knew before teaching him. The shared firewall applies to Kaze, Billy and Chris; Daniel's separately authorized rework joins via his owner. Recurring narrator/relay behavior uses `canon/presentation/PRESENTATION.md`; this does not give Chris Billy's travel or private knowledge.

## ORIGIN OF THE BOND
During a fictional trip to Louisiana, Chris was already on an extremely large first-time LSD trip. In the story, he astral-projected and encountered Catfish Billy in an astral realm.

They became extremely close over a subjective span that felt like eons even though only a very short amount of ordinary time may have passed. When Chris returned to his physical body, Catfish Billy came back with him, creating the continuing transformation bond.

This is fictional supernatural canon. It is NOT a real-world claim that LSD causes astral projection and is not drug-use advice.

## TRANSFORMATION / RAPID BOND SWITCH
The transformation is a **full-body inside-out jaw switch**. To bring Billy out, Chris's jaw opens impossibly past his chest; Billy grips/pulls the opening and Chris's body peels inside-out around him until Billy is the single exterior body. Chris passes into BELLY OF THE BILLY. In reverse, Chris emerges through Billy's opening and pulls Billy inside-out; Billy becomes the full-size interior occupant while Chris is the single exterior body. Skin/flesh folds remain one continuous transformation, not a discarded corpse or second body.

No defecated mini-Billy, regurgitate/shrink/swallow chain, lingering husk, separate summon or stable miniature companion remains. The visual can be horrible while the **near-instant practical switch** remains fast enough for actual combat and tool handoffs. Detail in prose never inserts seconds of mandatory transformation delay.
